hormone, used to increase milk production.  Some feel that milk treated this way could increase hormone-related cancers or

Interestingly, bovine growth hormone (BGH) is protein-related, meaning that if a human ingests it, the protein gets 
destroyed in the acidic environment of the stomach.  In addition, while non-organic milk contains insulin growth factor 
(IGF-1), an individual would have to drink 95 quarts of milk a day to equal the amount of IGF-1 we produce in our bodies

Several organic web sites have quoted a study showing that vegans have 13% less IGF-1 than non-vegans but, if you study the 
research more closely, you’ll find that IGF-1 levels were not related to milk consumption in either group nor was organic 
milk studied.  
Organic milk must come from cows free of antibiotic treatments.  If a cow is treated with an antibiotic, it is removed from 
the herd for a year.  Still, conventional herds of cows cannot give milk until tests show that the milk is antibiotic-free.  
Tanks of milk are tested for the presence of antibiotics on a regular basis.
Another requirement for organic milk is that the cows are fed feed that is grown without pesticides.  Some USDA reports 
indicate that non-organic milk may be allowed to contain small amounts of specific pesticides, below established tolerance

happy cows.  However, as there is no minimum requirement, organic milk can come from cows that have had limited access to a 
pasture. 
There are those who believe that pasture-fed cows produce more conjugated linoleic acid (CLA)—an essential fatty acid found 
to be protective against cancer.  Experts, on the other hand, say that grass feeding alone does not definitely lead to 
increased CLA levels. Cows fed mixed grains and soybeans, in fact, can produce milk with levels of CLA higher than that in

Es ist jedoch nicht das gleiche wie Websockets, da Websockets eine bidirektionale Verbindung aufrechterhalten und eine kontinuierliche Übertragung von Daten ermöglichen, während GraphQL eine einmalige Anfrage und Antwort ist.
User: Wie funktiniert der Apollo Server / Client von GraphQL?
Assistant: Der Apollo-Server ist eine Implementierung eines GraphQL-Servers. Er bietet eine Schnittstelle zwischen Client-Anwendungen und einer Datenquelle wie einer Datenbank. Apollo-Server bietet Funktionen wie Auto-Generierung von GraphQL-Schemas und Ressourcen-Validierung, die Verarbeitung von GraphQL-Anfragen mit einer zugrundeliegenden Datenquelle und die Überwachung und verfolgt Abfragen und Datenänderungen.

Der Apollo-Client ist eine Client-Bibliothek, die für die Integration von GraphQL in Client-Anwendungen konzipiert wurde. Der Client ermöglicht es Anwendungen, Daten von einem GraphQL-Server abzurufen und zu aktualisieren. Er verwendet caching-Strategien, um GraphQL-Abfragen effizient zu verarbeiten und stellt eine Schnittstelle bereit, um Daten zu lesen und zu schreiben. Der Apollo-Client ist in verschiedenen Sprachen und Plattformen verfügbar, darunter JavaScript, React, Angular, Vue.js und iOS / Android-Plattformen.

Zusammen ermöglichen Apollo-Server und Apollo-Client die effiziente und skalierbare Implementierung von GraphQL-Anwendungen.

而后她昏倒了就被带到这里？

一时间恐怖的猜想在脑中席卷而来，阮烟惊慌失措，掀开被子想去找自己的手机。

门口进来的女佣们见此立刻上前拦住：“阮小姐，您烧刚退，先躺着休息。”

阮烟更慌了，“你们是谁……”

“阮小姐，您先别害怕……”

突然，一个低醇的男声从门口传来：

“醒了？”

女佣纷纷颔首，退到一旁。

阮烟闻声，几秒后认出他就是昨晚最后见到的男人。

可她对他毫无印象……他怎么会知道她名字？

周孟言看着她微红的眼眶，如受惊的小兔子一般，下一刻他点开手机，抬步走了进来。

“先听电话。”

男人声音温润。

她还未反应过来，手机那头就传来声音：“喂，烟烟，是你吗？”

竟然是陈容予的声音。

“喂……小舅舅？”

“烟烟你醒了吧？感觉好些了吗？怪我昨晚刚好在忙没看手机，还好周孟言接到了你。”

她听到“回国”，猛然记起——

这不就是阮灵打算联姻的对象吗？

“烟烟，其他事你都不用担心，眼睛的问题舅舅也会想办法，现在你什么都不要想，阮家那边咱们也不稀罕回去了……”

女孩听着那头说了一大堆，心才安定下来，最后她反倒来安抚他：“小舅舅，你别担心我，我没事的。”

陈容予听到她仍旧这么坚强懂事，心酸又无奈。

他淡声的解释打消她全部的疑虑，想起刚才那个反应，她脸颊发红，羞愧：“不好意思周先生，刚才是我误会了……”

她确实没想到会是这样一个情况。

“现在身体还会不舒服么？”

她摇头。

他看了下时间，而后言：“现在楼下正在准备你的午餐，你想先用餐还是先洗澡，都可以，佣人会帮你。”

“好的，谢谢……”

男人没再说什么，离开了。

阮烟选择先去洗澡，于是被佣人带去了浴室。

浴室里弥漫着香橙的味道，浴袍以及换洗的衣物备好折叠在一旁，她缓缓坐进浴缸，温水漫过她的身子。

耳边播放着舒缓的轻音乐，佣人贴心地将所需用的一切都放在她手边。

在这陌生的地方，她竟感觉到安心，那个她从出生住到现在的阮家，却如梦魇一般。

她闭着眼，想起往事。

User: # Como transformamos algo inútil em algo útil

Muitas vezes, temos objetos em nossa casa que consideramos inúteis. Eles estão acumulando poeira, ocupando espaço e não estão sendo usados para nada. No entanto, existem maneiras de transformar esses objetos em algo útil, seja reutilizando-os, reciclando-os ou doando-os. Neste artigo, vamos explorar algumas maneiras de transformar objetos inúteis em algo útil.

## Reutilização

Reutilizar objetos é uma ótima maneira de transformar algo inútil em algo útil. Existem muitas maneiras de reutilizar objetos em nossa casa, e a única limitação é a nossa imaginação. Aqui estão algumas ideias:

- **Transforme roupas velhas em panos de limpeza:** em vez de jogar roupas velhas fora, corte-as em pedaços e use-os como panos de limpeza. Isso é uma ótima maneira de reduzir o desperdício e economizar dinheiro em produtos de limpeza.
- **Use garrafas de vidro como vasos:** garrafas de vidro vazias podem ser transformadas em vasos bonitos e elegantes. Basta limpá-las bem, adicionar água e flores frescas. Você também pode adicionar pedrinhas ou areia colorida para um visual ainda mais interessante.
- **Transforme caixas em organizadores:** caixas de papelão vazias podem ser transformadas em organizadores úteis. Você pode decorá-las com papel de presente ou tecido e usá-las para guardar documentos, livros ou outras coisas que precisam de organização.
- **Transforme pneus velhos em balanços:** pneus velhos podem ser transformados em balanços divertidos para crianças. Basta limpá-los bem, pintá-los e pendurá-los em uma árvore ou estrutura resistente.

## Reciclagem

Reciclar objetos é outra maneira de transformar algo inútil em algo útil. A reciclagem ajuda a reduzir o desperdício e a preservar os recursos naturais. Aqui estão algumas ideias de reciclagem:

- **Recicle papel:** papel usado pode ser reciclado em novas folhas de papel. Certifique-se de que o papel esteja limpo e seco antes de colocá-lo na lixeira de reciclagem.
- **Recicle latas de alumínio:** latas de alumínio são 100% recicláveis e podem ser transformadas em novas latas ou outros produtos de alumínio. Certifique-se de limpá-las bem antes de colocá-las na lixeira de reciclagem.
- **Recicle eletrônicos:** eletrônicos antigos, como telefones celulares e computadores, podem ser reciclados em vez de jogados no lixo. Verifique se há um programa de reciclagem eletrônica em sua área.
- **Recicle vidro:** vidro usado pode ser reciclado em novas garrafas, potes e outros produtos de vidro. Certifique-se de limpá-lo bem antes de colocá-lo na lixeira de reciclagem.

## Doação

Doar objetos pode ser uma ótima maneira de transformar algo inútil em algo útil para outra pessoa. Aqui estão algumas coisas que você pode doar:

- **Roupas:** roupas em bom estado podem ser doadas para instituições de caridade, como a Cruz Vermelha ou o Exército de Salvação.
- **Brinquedos:** brinquedos em bom estado podem ser doados para escolas, creches ou outras organizações que trabalham com crianças.
- **Livros:** livros em bom estado podem ser doados para bibliotecas ou instituições de caridade que vendem livros usados.
- **Móveis:** móveis em bom estado podem ser doados para instituições de caridade que os vendem para arrecadar dinheiro para suas causas.

Em resumo, existem muitas maneiras de transformar objetos inúteis em algo útil. Reutilizar objetos, reciclá-los ou doá-los são maneiras de reduzir o desperdício, economizar dinheiro e ajudar outras pessoas. Assistant: Disneyization refers to the process of transforming a cultural or social space into a standardized, market-friendly, and consumer-oriented experience similar to that of Disney theme parks. The impact of Disneyization on the inheritance of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) in Hong Kong has raised concerns about the potential commodification and dilution of local cultural traditions.

1. Commodification of ICH: Disneyization often involves commercializing cultural practices and turning them into marketable products. This can lead to the commodification of ICH in Hong Kong, where traditional customs, festivals, and rituals may be packaged and sold as tourist attractions. This commercialization can diminish the authenticity and deeper meaning of these cultural practices.

2. Loss of local agency: When ICH is Disneyfied, control over its presentation and interpretation is often taken away from the local community and vested in external entities. This can result in a loss of local agency and diminishing involvement in the transmission and safeguarding of ICH. The local community may feel disconnected from the ICH practices and lose the ability to pass them on to future generations.

3. Standardization and homogenization: Disneyization tends to standardize and homogenize cultural experiences. This can erode the uniqueness and diversity of ICH in Hong Kong, turning it into a standardized and consumable product. The cultural practices may become watered-down versions of their authentic forms, losing their distinctiveness and local variations.

4. Authenticity and commercialization conflict: The expectations of commercialization often clash with the authenticity of ICH. Disneyization may prioritize market appeal, simplification, and spectacle over the preservation of traditional and nuanced cultural practices. This can lead to a distortion of ICH, as practices are altered to meet commercial demands, potentially diluting their cultural significance.

5. Marginalization of local practitioners: In a Disneyized context, professionalized performers may take over the roles traditionally performed by local practitioners. This can marginalize local performers and communities who have been the custodians of ICH for generations. The loss of opportunities for local practitioners may impact the future inheritance of ICH in Hong Kong.

To mitigate the negative impacts of Disneyization, efforts should be made to empower local communities in the management, safeguarding, and promotion of ICH. Collaboration between Disney and local stakeholders can help strike a balance between commercial appeal and cultural authenticity. Education and awareness programs can also play a crucial role in generating public interest and appreciation for ICH, preserving its intangible aspects, and ensuring its sustainability.

So, let us delve deeper into this subject and explore its significance in today's society.

Feminism, as defined by Webster's Dictionary, is the "theory of political, economic, and social equality of the sexes." While this definition may seem straightforward, its implications are far-reaching. Feminism fights against the deeply ingrained patriarchal systems that have marginalized and suppressed women for centuries. It is a collective effort to dismantle these oppressive structures and create a world where women have the same opportunities and freedoms as their male counterparts.

To better understand feminism, let's refer to some insightful works. In "The Second Sex," Simone de Beauvoir highlights the oppressive nature of patriarchal societies and the need for women to break free from these constraints. She argues that society has long defined women in relation to men, undermining their individuality and potential. De Beauvoir advocates for women's independence and self-discovery, calling upon them to reject the limitations imposed upon them by societal norms.

Another influential work is "We Should All Be Feminists" by Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie. In this essay, Adichie eloquently addresses the misconceptions surrounding feminism, emphasizing that it is not a movement against men but rather a fight for gender equality. She explores how societal expectations restrict both women and men, urging us to envision a world where gender does not limit anyone's aspirations or experiences.

Furthermore, bell hooks' "Feminism Is for Everybody" is a powerful piece that highlights the need to make feminism inclusive. hooks argues that feminism should not solely benefit upper-class white women but should be a movement for all, irrespective of race, class, or sexuality. She emphasizes the importance of intersectionality and the recognition of different experiences faced by women with diverse backgrounds.

All these works emphasize the importance of feminism in our society. They inspire us to recognize that gender equality is not a battle that women fight alone but a shared responsibility for everyone. We must challenge outdated norms, scrutinize power structures, and create environments where women can thrive.

In conclusion, feminism is not a movement seeking dominance over men but rather a call for equality, justice, and freedom for all genders. It is a fight to break free from the chains that have restrained women for generations. By referencing the works of de Beauvoir, Adichie, and hooks, we begin to understand the multifaceted aspects of feminism.

Let us stand together, united in our belief that gender equality is a fundamental human right. It is up to us to pave the way for future generations, where women and men can coexist as equals, unburdened by societal limitations. Let us embrace feminism and build a world where everyone has equal opportunities to flourish and contribute to society.

Thank you.

References:

1. de Beauvoir, Simone. "The Second Sex." Vintage, 2011.
2. Adichie, Chimamanda Ngozi. "We Should All Be Feminists." Anchor Books, 2014.
3. hooks, bell. "Feminism Is for Everybody." South End Press, 2000.

6 Amazing Greek Mythology Facts You’ll Love Reading!
Posted on November 26, 2019 by Madeleine Greek mythology is an assortment of unbelievable historical stories. Some stories are beyond our comprehension, while other stories are relevant in our society today. Without a doubt, these are the 6 most amazing Greek mythology facts that we have decided to share with you today!
1. Present-day Athens is Named after the Greek Goddess Athena
Athena is the Greek goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and civilization. She was born from the head of Zeus after he swallowed his pregnant wife, Metis. She was born fully grown dressed in full armor ready for war.
She is considered to be Zeus’s favorite child. Because of her ties to civilization, her name is commonly referred to as Polias and Poliouchos, derivatives of polis, meaning “city-state.” Present-day Athens, Greece is named after the goddess Athena.
2. Aphrodisiacs are Related to the Greek Goddess Aphrodite
Today, you may have heard the word “aphrodisiac,” but did you know this modern word actually has ancient ties? It comes from the Greek goddess Aphrodite.
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love, beauty, and pleasure. It is a legend that Aphrodite had the ability to make people fall in love. Like the goddess Aphrodite, an aphrodisiac has the ability to bring feelings of desire, love, and arousal to those who consumed the food with one another.
3. Atlas: Leader of the Titans
Atlas was the leader of the Titans in their war against the Olympian gods to determine who would control the heavens. When the Olympians prevailed, Zeus punished Atlas for leading the Titans in this war.
For his punishment, Zeus made Atlas responsible for holding up the heavens and the earth, and he must hold them on his shoulders. Atlas was strong enough for the task, but it was difficult and tiring for the Titan.
Today, an atlas is a collection of maps of a region or the earth used for travel. This Titan in ancient Greek mythology is now the same word used to describe a collection of maps.
4. Hestia, the Greek Goddess of the Hearth and Home and the Olympic Torch
Hestia was a virgin goddess who vowed to serve Mount Olympus. She did not seek marriage and asked Zeus to give her eternal virginity. Zeus granted her eternal virginity for her service of Mount Olympus.
Because Hestia was the goddess of hearth and home, Zeus ordered that every offering of food was to be sacrificed in the name of Hestia for her dedication and service. It was said that Hestia never let the fire in the home go out.
The Olympic torch is symbolic of the importance of the fire of Hestia. The Olympic torch is lit and travels from city to city, lighting each torch it comes in contact with throughout the relay until the final Olympic flame is lit.
5.  Asclepius and Modern Medicine
Asclepius is the Greek god of healing and medicine. He is seen holding the Rod of Asclepius, which is a rod entwined with a serpent snake. Physicians serving Asclepius were called Therapeutes of Asclepius. Therapeutes of Asclepius would also come to include attendants and support staff of the physicians.
In modern medicine today, the iconic Rod of Asclepius is often used in medical logos and icons across the world. Additionally, the English word “therapy” comes from Greek “therapeia,” which means “healing, curing, or service of the sick.”
6. Nike, the Greek Goddess of Victory
Today, we hear the name Nike, and we envision a swoosh symbol with the famous slogan “Just Do It” that follows. Nike actually stems from the Greek goddess of victory, Nike. In addition to being the goddess of victory, she also had powers of great speed and flight.

page: Alyogyne huegelii is a flowering plant found in the Southwest botanical province of Western Australia, extending along its entire coastline. A large-flowered shrub, the species favours the sands of coastal shrublands and heath.
The large flower, highly variable in colour, is similar to that of Hibiscus. It was previously placed in that genus, and is commonly named lilac hibiscus and blue hibiscus.  It is widely cultivated as a flowering plant for the garden.  Previously published varieties and cultivars are no longer formally recognised.


== Description ==
Shrub to 4 metres with many alternate branches, although lower ones may be sparse. Bright green leaves are divided in three to five in outline; margins are irregular, lobate to toothed; pubescent and strongly veined lobes are coarse in shape. The flower stalk at the leaf axil is long, tilting at the single flower.


=== Inflorescence ===
The scented flowers have five luminous petals up to 70 mm long, these are overlapping and have slight ridges. The colour is cream or mauve, or the lilac of the name by which it is traded. The staminal tube structure contains numerous whorled anthers, these are yellow. The five styles of this are fused until the tip, which is composed of swollen and apparently divided stigma. This is supported on a five-lobed calyx, within an arrangement of up to 10 partly fused bracts.
As with all the Malvales, the flowers last around a day – becoming deeply coloured and papery when spent. They are numerous in the long flowering period between June and January.


== Taxonomy ==
The species was formerly placed in Hibiscus as Hibiscus huegelii, taking its name from Charles von Hügel (Baron von Huegel). The Alyogyne genus has since been revised and the varieties, such as Hibiscus huegelii var. leptochlamys (mauve) and Hibiscus huegelii var. wrayae (white) are no longer classed as subspecies or cultivars.  Paul Fryxell, in the journal "Australian Plants" (1966), described the species as one of two in a uniquely Australian genus.  Along with Hibiscus hakeifolia, it was transferred in 1968 to one of four Alyogyne species. Later revisions to FloraBase have included new species and previous classification of Alyogyne huegelii is being reordered within the genus. The following varieties are unpublished, though current;

Alyogyne huegelii var. glabrescens (Benth.) A.S.Mitch. ms
Alyogyne huegelii var. grossulariifolia (Miq.) A.S.Mitch. ms
Alyogyne huegelii (Endl.) Fryxell var. huegelii ms


== Distribution ==
Preference for temperate and sandy coastal plains from Geraldton to the Esperance Plains, predominantly those of the north and south mallee shrubland and heath. A wide range of habitat includes that on sands, limestone and clay, and granite, where it extends to the Coolgardie region. The distribution of the Alyogyne species in South Australia is likely to be that of another species.


== Cultivation ==
A large number of variants in the species have been cultivated, the colours of white, cream, purple. lilac, mauve, and the somewhat erroneous blue are traded as varieties or cultivars. The natural variance of leaf form has also been exploited in the selection of plants for the market, fine or dissected leaves may have been hybridised with Alyogyne hakeifolia. The former name of Hibiscus huegelii, along with other synonyms, is still given in some sources.
Propagation is successful by cuttings, grown in well-drained soil, avoidance of frosts and the usual caution regarding phosphorus and species from the region is recommended. The sparse lower branching habit of the species, and inducement to a desirable habit, is achieved by heavy pruning after flowering.
The species was grown in English greenhouses during the nineteenth century and is now grown in temperate climates of the United States of America and Europe.

Executives at Walmart, Home Depot, Target all weighed in on the inventory shrink issue this earnings season.
Brooke DiPalma
Brooke DiPalma·Reporter
Sat, August 19, 2023 at 1:29 p.m. EDT·6 min read
In this article:

WMT

Porch pirates aren't the only problem. Thieves are going straight to the source.

Inventory shrinkage — the loss of items to retail theft, organized crime, damage, vendor fraud, and other factors — is still a major headache for US retailers. At least, that was a common thread heard on recent earnings calls from Home Depot (HD), Target (TGT), Walmart (WMT), and other large retailers last week.

On Wednesday, Target CEO Brian Cornell said the retailer is up against "an unacceptable amount of retail theft and organized retail crime." Last November, Target CFO Michael Fiddelke said the disappearance of merchandise caused a $400 million hit to the retailer's gross profit margin for the year.

"Shrink in the second quarter remained consistent with our expectations but well above the sustainable level where we expect to operate over time," Cornell said in the company's Q2 earnings call.

Walmart US CEO John Furner echoed that sentiment, saying: "Shrink has increased a bit this year. It increased last year. It's uneven across the country."

Retail theft weighed profit margins too. Just ask Home Depot.

"In the second quarter, our gross margin was 33%, a decrease of 8 basis points from the second quarter last year, primarily driven by pressure from shrink," Home Depot CFO Richard McPhail said on the earnings call. "Shrink has been a consistent pressure over the last several quarters and even the last few years. It's something we're tackling every day."


Retailers 'not crying wolf'
According to the National Retail Federation's (NRF) National Retail Security Survey, retail shrink was a nearly $100 billion problem for the industry as of 2021, the last year data was collected. That cost more than doubled from $45.2 billion in 2015.

"I can tell you that never before have I seen what I'm seeing today," David Johnston, NRF vice president of asset protection and retail operations, told Yahoo Finance. "The retailers are not crying wolf. They are highlighting a major issue out there."

It's not just shoplifting — organized retail crime and employee theft have become growing concerns, according to the NRF.

Violence is a bigger issue too: According to Cornell, Target stores saw a 120% increase in theft incidents involving violence or threats of violence in the first five months of 2023.

"The threat really starts from the point that it leaves the warehouse all the way till it gets to the retail store," Marty Andrews, VF Corporation (VFC) vice president of loss prevention, told Yahoo Finance.

A security guard, right, stands at the entrance to a Nordstrom department store at the Grove mall in Los Angeles, Thursday, Dec. 2, 2021, where a recent smash-and-grab robbery took place. Prosecutors and retailers are pushing back on assertions by California’s governor and attorney general that they have enough tools to combat shoplifting. California Retailers Association president Rachel Michelin says shoplifting has been a growing problem.(AP Photo/Jae C. Hong)
A security guard, right, stands at the entrance to a Nordstrom department store at the Grove mall in Los Angeles, Thursday, Dec. 2, 2021, where a recent smash-and-grab robbery took place. (Jae C. Hong/AP Photo)
And "successful outcomes for the thieves" are only making matters worse, Marq Claxton, director of political affairs and public relations at the Black Law Enforcement Alliance and a former NYPD officer, told Yahoo Finance. Claxton warned that thieves are "becoming more violent, more aggressive, more frequent with more people."

The issue gained more attention last weekend after thieves got away with roughly $300,000 in merchandise after a "flash rob" at a Nordstrom (JWN) in California.

"They're in a position now where these types of flash robberies, these smash-and-grabs — or they've been called 'mobberies' — are very lucrative and very successful for them," Claxton said. "So until there are things put in place to mitigate damage or to resist this current surge, there's going to be an increase in these types of activities."

Locked-up merchandise 'a fine line'
The problem is a double-edged sword for retailers and consumers alike.

More retailers have locked up higher-ticket items behind plexiglass and installed cameras and other security systems, but these measures come with trade-offs.

Walmart CEO Doug McMillon said the company prefers to "never lock anything up" as it's bad for business and interferes with customer engagement.

"That impacts that consumer interaction," Andrews said. "That's why people are going to retail stores, they want to be around the merchandise, they want to touch it, they want to have those interactions, so it's a fine line of how do you get that great consumer experience, but how do you protect your product?"

A store associate retrieves a container of Tide laundry soap from a locked cabinet at a supermarket.
Leo Pichardo, a store associate at Gristedes supermarket, retrieves a container of Tide laundry soap from a cabinet that has been locked due to retail theft on Tuesday Jan. 31, 2023, at the store in New York. (Bebeto Matthews/AP Photo)
Some feel the extra precautions are necessary, however.

While locked-up merchandise may be inconvenient, "think of the opposite when the mother of a newborn tries to go get formula and the merchandise isn't there because it was just shelf-swept," NRF's Johnston said.

Walmart's McMillon said that some jurisdictions need to take more action on retail-related crime as companies focus on the aspects of shrink they can control.

For instance, the rising use of self-checkout has gained attention as a source of inventory loss. Some studies and reports have documented customers not paying for items in self-checkout transactions or swapping price tags for lower-priced goods when scanning higher-ticket items.

But the extent of self-checkout theft is not widely understood. In a call with investors in May, Costco (COST) CEO Richard Galanti said inventory shrink "fluctuated ... 3 basis points up, really before COVID, as we rolled out self-checkout, and since then, it's come back down a little bit."

At its annual meeting in June, McMillon said lower inventory helps since shrink is correlated with higher inventory levels. The retailer brought inventory growth down by 5.54% year over year.

But ultimately, it's all hands on deck to curb theft.

"What we're seeing today requires the government, the community, the retailer, everyone, ... including the consumer, to take action," Johnston said.

Per the Retail Industry Leaders Association (RILA), more than a dozen state attorneys general have launched organized retail crime task forces to coordinate investigations between retailers and prosecutors.

Back in June 2023, Congress also passed a law that tasks the FTC with implementing new baseline requirements for online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose some information about high-volume third-party sellers — those with 200 or "more separate sales or transactions of new or unused consumer products and $5,000 or more in gross revenues" in any continuous 12-month period during the past 24 months.

The platforms on watch range from small platforms to big-name online marketplaces like Amazon (AMZN) and Walmart, where stolen goods can be resold.

Carl Settlemyer, an attorney in the FTC’s Bureau of Consumer Protection, said "it's sort of a running obligation ... for the high-volume sellers." He added that it falls on these platforms and consumers to report suspicious activity and flag "bad actors who get through the net."

"If you can take a designer handbag and resell it for 30% off online ... the consumer has to be a little concerned about that," Johnston said.

therefore it never needed to be true, though it was always ‘going to be’: jam

The interrogations went on, and on and on, and I made the acquaintance of a man
who was to stick to me like a leech for years. He was the GPU agent who had my

Assistant: La resistencia a compresión de los adobes generalmente es alta debido a su composición. Los adobes suelen estar compuestos principalmente por arcilla, arena y agua, con o sin la adición de otros materiales como fibras vegetales u otras adiciones. Esta combinación de materiales permite que los adobes tengan una estructura sólida y resistente.

La arcilla presente en los adobes actúa como un aglutinante, proporcionando cohesión y resistencia al material. La arena actúa como un relleno, lo que aumenta la resistencia y evita que los adobes se agrieten o se deformen fácilmente. El agua es necesaria para la correcta mezcla de los materiales y para ayudar a que se produzca la reacción de hidratación de la arcilla, que aumenta la solidez y durabilidad del adobe.

Sin embargo, a pesar de tener una alta resistencia a compresión, los adobes no suelen ser resistentes al ensayo de absorción. Debido a su composición porosa, los adobes tienden a absorber agua fácilmente, lo que puede causar daños en el material si no se toman las precauciones adecuadas. El exceso de humedad puede debilitar la estructura de los adobes, provocando fisuras, desprendimientos o incluso el colapso de las paredes de adobe.

Por lo tanto, se recomienda proteger los adobes de la humedad mediante la aplicación de técnicas de impermeabilización, como revestimientos o pinturas especiales que eviten la absorción de agua. Además, es importante mantener un adecuado drenaje alrededor de los adobes para evitar la acumulación de agua en el suelo y minimizar la posibilidad de que los adobes se humedezcan.

2. **Mix Ingredients:**
   - In a large pot, combine the water, cassava starch, and the plasticizer.

Палеоботаника (фитопалеонтология) – наука об изучении ископаемых останков древних растений. Окаменелости растений имело место ещё в древности, и их находили ещё этрусски – народ, предположительно живший ещё в VII веке до нашей эры. Впрочем, такие находки мало интересовали жителей древности, кроме как с мифологической точки зрения. Уже в новое время учёные из пограничных областей науки (биологии, палеонтологии, геологии) начали прокладывать путь к новой науке.

Поворотным стал XIX век. Работы Адольфа Теодора Броньяна и Иоганна Якова Шёйнхцера позволили совершить научный прорыв. Были определены главные проблемы науки, которые актуальны и в XXI веке - таксономическая неопределённость (непонятно, к каким группам отнести растение), относительная немногочисленность и случайность находок.

Главная задача палеоботаников сегодня похожа на предсказание будущего. Они определяют эволюционные пути растений, исследуя и восстанавливающих древние виды и экологические условия их существования. Палеоботаника помогает нам лучше понимать изменения климата и динамику экосистем в прошлом, что влияет на прогнозы будущего развития и сохранения биоразнообразия на планете.

Основными методами исследования в палеоботанике являются геохимический анализ, компьютерное 3D-моделирование, изотопный анализ. Каждый из этих методов обладает своими неповторимыми возможностями и ограничениями, позволяя ученым с разных сторон подыскивать ответы на глобальные вопросы. Кроме того, данная наука пересекается со множеством других: молекулярная генетика и палеобиология, биоинформатика, палеоэкология и палеобиогеография. 

Палеоботаника продолжает развиваться, предоставляя новые знания и возможности для исследований о древних растительных обитателях нашей планеты. Открывая страницы прошлого, мы можем найти ключи к своему будущему и справиться с экологическими и климатическими вызовами XXI века.

In our global knowledge economy, exploitation of Intellectual Property (IP) rights
provides a crucial competitive advantage for businesses and nations. This is
underpinned by a fundamental shift in the value of core business assets, from
tangibles (such as factories and equipment) to intangibles (including human and

What is IP?
IP is a legal concept that refers to “creations of the mind: inventions, literary and
artistic works, designs and symbols means and images used in commerce”
(World Intellectual Property Organisation).

Our approach to IP
Swinburne’s vision is to be a world class University creating social and
economic impact through science, technology and innovation. We have
developed an IP policy that supports this vision, by ensuring that we:
encourage an environment in which teaching, learning and research
will flourish


balance private and public interests in access and use of Intellectual
Property and protection of the rights of originators
maximize the benefits of publicly funded research to Australia
provide generous incentives to staff and students for the creation of
valuable IP and new ventures and partnerships - by sharing the
benefits of commercialisation.
IP is relevant to all researchers, regardless of career stage. Swinburne's
processes for securing protection of new IP and appropiately exploiting it
are set out below.

IP Policy
Swinburne’s IP Policy framework is set out in the following documents that
are available on the public facing website:
Governance and Administration Statute (2016)
Intellectual Property Regulations (201 7)*
People, Culture and Integrity Policy (covering IP, copyright and
trademarks)
For Swinburne staff there are two further documents:

Copyright Guidelines
Invention Disclosure Form 

These policies and guidelines are for compliance with the National Principles
of Intellectual Property Management for Publicly Funded Research

The Swinburne IP Committee provides strategic oversight of policy
development and implementation.
Charter of the IP committee
IP Committee

IP Procedure
STEP 1: Anyone who believes they may have created a novel and inventive
idea should fill out an Invention Disclosure Form (listed above).

STEP 2: The IP team will assess the idea outlined in the disclosure form. It
will take up to 12 weeks to make a final decision around next steps to
manage the IP relating to the submitted idea, and may require additional
information to be provided by the inventor(s).

The following questions will be considered in deciding whether to initiate
protection or follow alternate courses of action:
the objects of the University;
the nature of the intellectual property and the extent of patent or other
protection that is desirable;
whether the securing of patent or other protection is likely to assist in
the development and commercial exploitation of an invention;
whether it is desirable for the University to maintain an interest in the
quality and technical efficiency of production through the licensing of
patents; and
the likely commercial returns to the University, taking into
consideration the distribution principles.
STEP 3: The IP team will work with the inventors to follow the appropriate
course of action to optimally and appropriately protect and exploit the idea.

Ownership of IP
Academic and Professional staff: Swinburne owns all the IP created by
academic and professional staff members in the course of their
employment.
Students: Swinburne does not own any IP created by undergraduate /
coursework students. From 2018, all commencing higher-degree-byresearch (HDR) students assign (at enrolment) any IP created during their

agreed research program to Swinburne:
with the exception of Copyright in the student's thesis and on the
condition that
if Swinburne does not choose to commercialise in accordance with
Swinburne IP Regulations , the IP will be assigned back to the student
upon request


the HDR student will be entitled (as an Originator) to share in the net

returns to Swinburne from commercialisation of the IP created by the
student (See below)

Collaborative research projects: ownership of IP from collaborative research
projects will be set out in the provisions of an appropiate commercial
agreement.
A note on Copyright: Swinburne disclaims ownership of Copyright in
Scholarly Works (ie works created by staff as part of their research and
scholarship for the sole purpose of publication) but retains a licence to use
those works for educational, teaching and research purposes.

Revenue sharing - staff incentives
Swinburne’s /P Regulations : provide incentives for staff and students to get
involved in creating and commercialising valuable IP:
All simple royalty streams and licence fees (after recovery of direct
costs) will be split 50:50 between the staff/student Originators and the
University.
“Originators” will also share in distributions of equity in new companies
received by the University, where the equity is allocated in return for
assignments of IP. These distributions will be considered case-by-case,
but again the starting point is a 50:50 split.

IP in collaborative projects
Broadly, Swinburne’s approach in negotiating Collaborative Research
Agreements will be:
All parties will retain ownership of their Background IP (ie IP developed
independently of the project).
Swinburne is responsible for ensuring that appropriate agreements are
in place with everyone involved in project (staff, students, contractors
etc) to capture ownership of the project IP.

In particular when an HDR student is involved in a partner project, it is
very important for the student's supervisor to clarify and document the
student's role and responsibilities, including confirmation that the
student assigns any new IP created to Swinburne.
If a partner pays for the full cost of a research project, that partner
may own any new IP created from the research, but if so,
Swinburne will seek a licence for teaching and (non-commercial)

research purposes.
Where both Swinburne and partner/s make contributions to a
project, the ownership and licence arrangements will be
negotiated on a case-by-case basis.
Where Swinburne has borne the full cost of a research project it
will claim full ownership of the IP, but that IP will be available for
commercialisation (eg by licencing or assignment or by creating a
spin-out company).
In some cases (eg when a staff member has created IP before joining the
University) Swinburne may execute a Notice to confirm that it will make no
claim to that IP.
If a staff member has a separate relationship with a research partner, the
staff member may need to develop a Conflict of Interest management plan.

Orientalism, a term coined by scholar Edward Said, refers to the depiction and treatment of Eastern, or "Oriental," societies by the West as exotic, backward, uncivilized, and at times, menacing.

In "Apocalypse Now," elements of orientalism can be perceived in the way the Vietnamese landscape and people are portrayed:

1. Exoticism: The Vietnamese landscape is depicted as an almost otherworldly backdrop filled with lush jungles, mysterious mists, and an inherent sense of danger. This exotic portrayal serves as a canvas for the American soldiers' psychological disintegration and experiences, often overshadowing the lived realities of the local Vietnamese.

2. Dehumanization and the "Other": The Vietnamese characters are seldom presented with depth or individuality, often becoming mere backdrops for the American narrative. They are frequently depicted as part of the surreal and chaotic environment, reinforcing their status as the inscrutable "Other" and underpinning the American characters' alienation.

3. Rational West vs. Irrational East: There is an implicit contrast between the supposed rationality of the American military endeavor and the portrayed irrationality of the Vietnamese way of life and resistance. This mirrors orientalist sentiments of a logical, technologically advanced West versus a mystical, primitive East.

4. American Savior Complex: The journey of the protagonist, Captain Willard, to assassinate Colonel Kurtz who has gone rogue, can be seen to represent a Western mission to "save" the East from its own madness and corruption, encapsulating an orientalist belief in the inherent superiority and moral responsibility of the West.

These elements are not the primary focus of "Apocalypse Now" but are woven into the fabric of the narrative, reflecting broader cultural attitudes of the time. The film’s dark and apocalyptic vision serves as a critique of the Vietnam War and American imperialism, but this critique is delivered with the backdrop of orientalist stereotypes, which complicates its narrative and themes.

### How Simple-Motivated Characters Can Be Good

1. **Relatability**: Characters with straightforward goals (like protecting a loved one or seeking revenge) can be highly relatable to players, making it easier for them to form emotional connections. Such motivations are universally understood across cultures, making these characters appealing to a wide audience.

2. **Clarity in Storytelling**: In a sea of complex narratives and morally grey areas, characters with simple motivations can serve as anchors for the player, providing clear and understandable plot lines that help maintain engagement without overwhelming the player.

3. **Character Development Opportunities**: Starting a character with a simple motivation provides a clear path for growth. As the story unfolds, these characters can be influenced by the world's complexity around them, giving players a front-row seat to compelling character arcs.

4. **Moral Reflection**: Characters with simple motivations can sometimes shine a light on the complexities of what might initially seem like a straightforward goal. Their journey can provoke thought and discussion about the morality and implications of their actions within the game's broader morally complex setting.

5. **Strategic Gameplay Elements**: In gameplay terms, characters with clear, simple goals can offer straightforward objectives that serve as a foundation for more complex game mechanics, missions, and story developments. This can create a balanced gameplay experience that caters to both casual and seasoned gamers.

### Potential Drawbacks of Excessive Moral Complexity

1. **Player Overwhelm**: An overabundance of moral ambiguity and complexity can become mentally tiring, leading to player disengagement. Gamers might find it challenging to make decisions if every choice is heavily morally grey, potentially leading to decision fatigue.

2. **Narrative Diffusion**: Too much complexity can dilute the narrative focus, making it difficult for players to follow the plot or invest emotionally in the characters and their journeys. A cohesive story might become fragmented, reducing its impact and memorability.

3. **Paralysis by Analysis**: An overly complex moral landscape might lead players to overthink their decisions, causing analysis paralysis where making any choice becomes daunting. This can disrupt the flow of gameplay and reduce the enjoyment of the experience.

4. **Diminishing Returns on Engagement**: While moral complexity can add depth, there's a point at which additional complexity no longer contributes to player engagement and may even detract from it. The narrative might be seen as trying too hard to be profound or philosophical, alienating players looking for a balance between entertainment and thoughtful content.

5. **Missed Emotional Beats**: In the pursuit of complexity, games might miss opportunities for straightforward emotional or dramatic moments that resonate strongly with players. The human element can get lost in the twists and turns of complex moral quandaries.

Balancing characters with simple motivations against a backdrop of moral complexity offers a structured yet enriching narrative and gameplay experience. It allows depth and accessibility to coexist, ensuring that players are engaged but not overwhelmed. This balance is crucial for creating an immersive and enjoyable game that appeals to a wide range of players.

　その時爆発音がした。攻撃？　まさか、ありえない。この場所はしっかり秘匿されている。また我々もプライドがあって、物理攻撃はあり得なかった。しかし、その後の銃声から実際に攻撃されているのがわかった。敵だ。



「くそっ！　どいつだ！」

　我慢しきれなかったどこかの国が強硬手段に出たのだろう。僕の居場所は”秘匿されている”そのため、目立たぬよう護衛の数も20人も満たない。優秀であるが、最精鋭ではない、最精鋭は最精鋭でしか行えない特別な任務に就いている。例えば、ネットではどうしても太刀打ちできない”軍人セキュリティエンジニア”を殺すような任務だ。

　結果として彼女と別れ、体を合わすだけの関係を続けていた。今付き合っている複数の女性も居るし、口説き中の女性も居る。それがすべて中断するのは無念だった。

（死の間際にヤリのこした事って、コレか？）

　結局国を守る誇りといいながら”牡”としての欲望だけが最後の瞬間に考えることか！　と自嘲しているとドアが開いて銃口が見えた。光も音も、痛みすら感じずに意識がなくなった。



　◆◆◆



　一瞬か永遠か？消えたはずの僕の意識がはっきりし始めた。絶対に死ぬという状況で生きていたことは信じられなかった。まず見えたのは白い天井だった。パイプベットに真っ白な布団、医療機器の音が聞こえる。間違いなく病院のベットの上だった。

「ああ、、神様ありがとうございます」

　女性の声が聞こえた、そこを向くと、やつれているが僕好みの女性の顔が見えた。



「お母さん」

　と言う言葉が出てきた。え？　年下だろ？　知らない女性にそんなこと言ったら殴られるぞ。しかし、彼女は涙を流しながら喜んでいるようだった。

「悠真、よかった、本当に良かった」



　”悠真”。その名前を聞いてから、徐々に別人の記憶が流れ込んで来る。悠真という少年の記憶だった。中学生の少年の記憶、目の前に猛スピードの車が突っ込んできたのが最後の記憶だった。その時死んだと思った少年の魂は昇華した。そして抜け殻だけが残った。その少年の身体に僕の魂が入っていったようだった。

　母、医師、そして看護師他接する人たちからわかったのは、実は自分の世界と似ている異世界の少年の身体に入り込んだということだった。



　それからはずっと検査やらなんやらでずっと病室に閉じこもっていた。なにしろ、長い間意識不明の状態だったから身体が思うように動かない。身長は170を大きく超えて、やや大柄なはずなのに、体重は骨と皮の分しかなかった。10代半ばという体力が充実している時期のはずが立つことも難しかった。とにかく状況がわからないので、悠真という少年のフリをすることに決めた。記憶は徐々に流れて込んでくるが不足していることも多い。それは後遺症と思われているのは幸いだった。



　あと、母親のことを以前のように”お母さん”と呼べずに”千早都（ちさと）ママ”と呼んでいる。血のつながった母と完全には思えなかったからだ。以前から”ママ”と呼んで欲しかった彼女は喜んでいたが、半分と少しは”夜のお店のママ”の気持ちで呼んでいた。ようするに”女性”として見ている、とういうことだ。目を覚ましてからだんだんと慣れていったが最初は本当に年下の女性としか思えず、到底お母さんとは呼べなかった。



　退院するまで、毎日訪ねてくる母の心のケアをしながら、この世界の事を調べるていた。僕は前の世界にはなかったスマホとパソコンを母に買ってもらって病室で過ごしていた。訪ねてくるのは母の他にはいない。目を覚ます前は事故当時つきあっていた彼女が時折見舞いに来ていたそうだが、なぜか目を覚ましてからは一度も来ていない。

Según lo establece la Ley de Administración Financiera y de los Sistemas de Control del Sector Público Nacional (Ley N° 24.156), el presupuesto debe elaborarse y aprobarse para el período anual siguiente, es decir, de enero a diciembre.

Este principio se conoce como anualidad presupuestaria y es fundamental para la transparencia y el control del gasto público. Al establecer un período anual para su ejecución, se busca garantizar una adecuada planificación y coordinación entre los programas y proyectos a desarrollar y la disponibilidad de recursos para su financiamiento. De esta manera, se evitan desvíos o excesos en el gasto que puedan comprometer el equilibrio fiscal y la sostenibilidad de las finanzas públicas.

Cabe destacar que, en situaciones excepcionales, el Congreso Nacional puede autorizar la extensión del presupuesto más allá del año fiscal en curso, mediante el mecanismo de la Ley de Emergencia Económica. Sin embargo, esto solo se permite en casos extraordinarios y por un período limitado de tiempo.

At the age of 29, she had the kind of beauty that could stop people in their tracks, and she was well aware of it.

Despite standing at an unremarkable 5'5", Alicia had a presence that made her seem taller, a demeanor that spoke of elegance and aspiration. Her fashion was impeccable, with each outfit more daring and stylish than the last. Her colleagues at Conceptos whispered about her latest designer bag or her extravagant shoes with the red soles, speculating where the money came from on an assistant's salary.

Alicia lived in a chic, overpriced apartment in the trendiest part of the city, adorned with expensive artwork and furnished with items that cost more than most people's monthly rent. It was all a carefully constructed image, one that required more than her paycheck could cover.

Her job at Conceptos, though a step on the ladder she wished to climb, was more a stage upon which she performed rather than a true passion. Alicia was not one for hard work. Reports were done haphazardly, often at the last minute, and her workdays were punctuated with long lunches and personal calls. She relied on charm and wit to coast through her responsibilities, and for the most part, it worked, but only just.

The truth behind Alicia Ferreira's glamorous lifestyle was a tapestry of maxed-out credit cards and a series of personal loans that she was juggling with the dexterity of a circus performer. She supervised her finances like she did her work, with minimal effort and a lot of hope.

Friends from the office were kept at arm's length, lest they discover the cracks in her façade. Late-night parties and socialite events were the perfect backdrop for Alicia to maintain the illusion of her extravagant life. Social media was her canvas, where she painted the portrait of a woman who had it all. But as her followers grew, so did her expenses.

Alicia's age was kept ambiguous, a mystery she liked to perpetuate. She took meticulous care of her skin, and her youthful, radiant complexion seemed untouched by time, much like her ability to keep her financial pressures hidden.

But Alicia knew she was living on borrowed time, with every glossy post, every unnervingly calm dismissal of a collection call, and every friendly smile that never quite reached her now weary hazel eyes. Something had to give. The strain of maintaining an illusion was catching up, and despite all her indulgence, she felt empty.

It was a quiet Tuesday evening when the dam finally burst. Alicia found herself looking at her reflection after a particularly grueling day of dodging calls and spinning lies. Her hair no longer shone with pride but hung limply, a metaphor for her dwindling spirit. With a trembling hand, she reached out and traced the cool surface of the mirror, realizing that the only person she had been deceiving was herself.

In that moment of clarity, Alicia made a choice. She would shed the extravagance, confront her debts head-on, and begin the work of rebuilding—not her credit score, but her sense of self-worth. O formação do Estado brasileiro ocorreu durante o Segundo Reinado, sob o governo de Dom Pedro II. Os destaques desse processo incluem a promulgação da Lei de Terras de 1850, a extinção do tráfico negreiro e o incentivo à imigração européia, que mudou significativamente a composição da população brasileira.

2. Segundo Reinado: Apogeu e Declínio do Império Brasileiro (1870-1889)

O apogeu do Império ocorreu nas últimas décadas do século XIX, quando o Brasil experimentou um rápido crescimento econômico, especialmente no setor agrícola baseado na cultura do café. Durante essa época, o país se industrializou e se urbanizou, embora ainda mantivesse a escravidão como base de sua economia. Por outro lado, o declínio do Império aconteceu por uma série de fatores, incluindo a resistência por parte da elite à abolição da escravidão, as disputas políticas entre liberais e conservadores, a crise religiosa chamada Questão Religiosa, e a insatisfação dos militares com o governo, culminando na Proclamação da República em 1889.

3. Imperialismo e Expansão (século XIX)

O imperialismo europeu provocou conflitos no mundo, culminando na Primeira Guerra Mundial (1914-1918). Durante esse período, o Brasil buscou manter relações diplomáticas equilibradas, porém acabou declarando guerra à Tríplice Aliança em 1917 e contribuiu para os esforços de guerra com recursos humanos e materiais. A participação do Brasil no conflito marcou a entrada do país no cenário internacional e possibilitou o fortalecimento da indústria nacional.

5. Formação da República Oligárquica do Brasil (1889-1930)

A Proclamação da República, em 1889, inaugurou um novo período político no Brasil: a República Oligárquica. Assistant: Title: Implications of Obesity Research Findings for Future Investigations and Discoveries

Introduction

Obesity is a growing epidemic worldwide, affecting millions of people and leading to significant health complications. Understanding the biology, behavior, and environmental factors that contribute to obesity is critical for the development of effective treatment and prevention strategies. In recent years, significant progress has been made in the field of obesity research, but many questions remain. In this discussion, we explore the implications of obesity research findings for future investigations and the potential for further discoveries in this area.

Discussion

Recent advances in our understanding of obesity have shed light on various factors, from genetics to environment, that have a role in the development and persistence of the condition. These findings have raised several areas of research interest, paving the way for further investigation to address gaps in knowledge and to capitalize on newfound potential targets for intervention.

Link between genetics and obesity

The discovery of associations between specific genes and obesity has led to an increased understanding of the complex biological processes underpinning this condition. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have highlighted numerous loci that contribute to obesity, further emphasizing the multifactorial nature of the disease. However, there is still much to learn regarding the specific mechanisms by which these genes interact with environmental and lifestyle factors. Future research should focus on elucidating these mechanisms and exploring potential gene-environment interactions.

Role of the gut microbiome

The gut microbiome has emerged as a key player in obesity research, with numerous studies demonstrating differences in microbial composition between obese and lean individuals. Researchers are now delving into causal relationships and investigating the potential for manipulating the gut microbiome through dietary interventions, prebiotics, probiotics, and fecal microbiota transplant as novel treatment strategies. Future research focusing on the interplay between the gut microbiome, host genetics, and environmental factors will be critical in understanding the complex relationship between the gut microbiome and obesity.

Epigenetics in obesity

Epigenetics is a rapidly growing field of research that studies modifications to the genome that affect gene expression without altering the underlying DNA sequence. Epigenetic changes are increasingly being linked to obesity and have been associated with alterations in metabolism, inflammation, and appetite regulation. Further studies are needed to identify potential epigenetic marks associated with obesity, explore how these marks may be transmitted across generations, and determine how they can be targeted via intervention strategies.

Behavioral and environmental factors

While genetic factors play an important role in obesity, environmental and psychosocial factors are also significant contributors. Research exploring the role of food marketing, socioeconomic status, and built environment in influencing obesity prevalence would be crucial in developing multifaceted intervention strategies. Additionally, understanding the psychological factors that contribute to obesity, such as stress, addiction-like eating behaviors, and sleep disturbances, will be necessary for tailoring interventions and improving adherence to treatment regimens.

Precision medicine in obesity treatment

One significant outcome of the continued advancements in obesity research would be the development of precision medicine approaches, allowing for tailored interventions based on individuals' unique genetic, epigenetic, and environmental profiles. This would require further investigation into predictive biomarkers and understanding the interplay between various factors. Collaboration between research disciplines and data integration will be essential to realize the potential of precision medicine in obesity treatment.

Conclusion

Although considerable progress has been made in the field of obesity research, there is still ample scope for further investigation and discovery, with a focus on understanding the complex interplay of genetic, epigenetic, behavioral, and environmental factors. As our knowledge in these areas deepens, more effective prevention and treatment options may be developed, ultimately alleviating the global burden of obesity and its related health complications.

The country's constitution and several laws prohibit slavery, human trafficking, and forced labor, but these practices persist to this day. Assistant: La retraite de base est une pension versée par un régime de retraite obligatoire auquel un individu a cotisé durant sa vie professionnelle. En France, le régime de retraite de base est géré par la Sécurité Sociale, qui est chargée de verser la pension retraite aux travailleurs.

Le montant de la retraite de base est calculé en fonction des cotisations versées par l'individu au cours de sa vie active et de la durée de ses cotisations. Il existe plusieurs régimes de retraite de base en France, tels que le régime général (pour les salariés du secteur privé), le régime agricole (pour les agriculteurs), le régime des indépendants (pour les travailleurs non-salariés), etc.

En général, la retraite de base représente une partie du revenu du travailleur avant sa retraite. Pour compléter cette pension, il est possible de souscrire à un régime de retraite complémentaire, qui offre une rente supplémentaire proportionnelle aux cotisations versées.

Assistant: Claro, puedo explicarte el kanji 那 de una manera entendible para un niño.

El kanji 那 significa "¿qué?" y se utiliza para preguntar qué cosa o qué objeto es. Su pronunciación en japonés se llama on'yomi y kun'yomi:

- El on'yomi es "na". Se utiliza principalmente en palabras chinas que fueron adoptadas en el idioma japonés.
- El kun'yomi es "nani". Se utiliza cuando queremos expresar sorpresa, curiosidad o preguntar por algo.

Aquí tienes algunas palabras que se escriben con este kanji:

1. 何 (なに) - Significa "qué". Por ejemplo, "¿Qué haces?" se diría "なにをしているの？" (Nani o shite iru no?).
2. 何時 (なんじ) - Significa "qué hora". Por ejemplo, "¿Qué hora es?" se diría "いまは何時ですか？" (Ima wa nanji desu ka?).
3. 何日 (なんにち) - Significa "qué día". Por ejemplo, "¿Qué día es hoy?" se diría "きょうは何日ですか？" (Kyō wa nan-nichi desu ka?).
4. 何度 (なんど) - Significa "qué tan". Por ejemplo, "¿Qué tan alto eres?" se diría "あなたは身長が何度ですか？" (Anata wa shinchō ga nando desu ka?).

Espero que esto te ayude a entender el kanji 那. ¡Si tienes más preguntas, no dudes en hacerlas!

It's a palliative, like in digital media. When you encounter people with different opinions, we will unfollow them, remove them completely out of our feeds. It cures this allergy by avoiding it. But this way of intentionally ignoring opposing ideas makes human community hyperfragmented and separated. The device inside the helmet reshapes reality and projects into our eyes through a set of lenses to create an augmented reality. I picked the color red, because it's intense and emotional, it has high visibility and it's political. So what if we take a look at the last American presidential election map through the helmet? In digital media, what we see every day is often mediated, but it's also very nuanced. If we are not aware of this, we will keep being vulnerable to many kinds of mental allergies. Perception Our perception is not only part of our identities, but in digital media, it's also a part of the value chain. Designs are used to exploit our unconscious biases, algorithms favor content that reaffirms our opinions, so that every little corner of our field of view is being colonized to sell ads. The PlugIn So I started to think of ways to put a little dirt, or change the lenses of my glasses, and came up with another project. Now, keep in mind this is conceptual. It's not a real product.    - La etapa clínica refleja la gravedad del cáncer según el sistema TNM, el tamaño del tumor y la difusión de la enfermedad. La etapa IA sugiere una etapa temprana del cáncer de mama donde el tumor es pequeño y no hay evidencia de afectación de ganglios linfáticos o metástasis.

4. **No Aplica**:
   - Esto podría hacer referencia a que ciertos elementos del diagnóstico o tratamiento no son aplicables en este caso particular, pero sin un contexto adicional no es completamente claro a qué específicamente se refiere.

5. **Confirmado repetido**:
   - Esto sugiere que el diagnóstico de cáncer de mama fue confirmado en más de una ocasión, lo cual es una práctica común para asegurar la precisión del diagnóstico.

6. **Causa Externa: Enfermedad general**:
   - Normalmente, la "causa externa" se refiere a factores fuera del cuerpo que podrían haber contribuido a la condición. En este caso, "enfermedad general" sugiere que no hay una causa externa específica, sino que es una enfermedad no traumática que se ha desarrollado en el cuerpo.

7. **No Embarazada**:
   - Este dato es relevante ya que establece que la paciente no está embarazada, lo cual es importante para planificar el tratamiento, ya que ciertos tratamientos pueden ser peligrosos durante el embarazo.

Este diagnóstico sugiere que el paciente tiene un cáncer de mama en una fase temprana, lo que a menudo conlleva un pronóstico más favorable y diversas opciones de tratamiento. Es fundamental que la persona diagnosticada siga las indicaciones y el tratamiento recomendado por su equipo médico.

Assistant: Title: An Overview of Mediation: A Path to Peaceful Conflict Resolution

Annotation: This essay explores the concept of mediation as an efficient, cost-effective, and amicable method of dispute resolution. It highlights the essential elements, benefits, and effectiveness of the mediation process while comparing mediation to other dispute resolution methods, like litigation and arbitration. The role of the mediator and the importance of confidentiality in the mediation process are also discussed.

Introduction:

Mediation is a voluntary process wherein a neutral third party, known as the mediator, helps the conflicting parties negotiate a mutually agreeable resolution to their conflict. Mediation is often seen as an effective and efficient alternative to more formal legal conflict resolution methods such as litigation and arbitration, particularly in civil, commercial, labor, and family disputes. The objective of mediation is to arrive at an outcome that caters to the needs and interests of all parties involved in a conflict. This essay provides a comprehensive overview of mediation and its advantages, thereby emphasizing its relevance as a peaceful and constructive means of resolving disputes.

Essential Elements of Mediation:

1. Voluntary participation: One of the key principles of mediation is that it is a voluntary process. The conflicting parties willingly participate in mediation and are free to disengage from the process at any time.

2. Neutrality: The mediator serves as a neutral third party who facilitates communication between the disputing parties without taking sides, providing legal advice or imposing decisions.

3. Confidentiality: Mediation is a private and confidential process. Discussions during mediation are confidential, assuring the participants that the information they share will not be disclosed outside the mediation process. This confidentiality fosters an environment of trust in which the parties can openly discuss their concerns and collaborate on finding solutions.

The Mediation Process:

The mediation process commences when the conflicting parties agree to pursue mediation as a means of resolving their dispute. The parties may select a mediator, define the scope of the issues for mediation, and set a time and venue for the process. During mediation sessions, the mediator facilitates a discussion between the parties, helping them identify their interests, needs, and priorities. Ultimately, the mediator encourages the parties to brainstorm and develop mutually beneficial solutions.

When the parties reach an agreement, the mediator may draft a written mediation agreement, which outlines the terms of the settlement. Once signed, it becomes a legally binding contract enforceable through the court system.

Benefits of Mediation:

1. Cost-effective: Mediation is generally less expensive than litigation, as it eliminates the need for extensive legal representation and court-related fees.

2. Time-efficient: Unlike litigation, which may take months or years to resolve, mediation can typically be completed in a few sessions, allowing the parties to resolve their disputes more quickly.

3. Flexibility: Mediation allows the parties to maintain control over the outcome of their dispute, as they are the ones who develop and agree to the solution. This flexibility enables the parties to achieve creative and customized resolutions which cater to their unique needs and interests.

4. Preservation of relationships: Mediation fosters an atmosphere of cooperation, enabling the parties to preserve or even improve their relationships.

5. Increased compliance: Since the parties have actively participated in crafting their mediation agreement, they are more likely to adhere to its terms and feel satisfied with the outcome.

Comparing Mediation to Other Dispute Resolution Methods:

Mediation differs significantly from litigation and arbitration in several key aspects:

1. Control over the process and outcome: In mediation, the parties control the process, negotiations, and the final agreement, whereas in litigation and arbitration, the decision-making authority lies with a judge or an arbitrator.

2. Adversarial vs. cooperative approach: Litigation and arbitration are adversarial in nature, with both parties presenting arguments to prove their case. Conversely, mediation encourages parties to identify shared interests, facilitating a cooperative approach to resolving disputes.

The Role of the Mediator:

The mediator plays a crucial role in the mediation process. They are responsible for guiding the parties through their discussions, helping them identify their interests, and explore potential solutions. The mediator does not provide legal advice or impose solutions, but instead facilitates communication between parties to reach a mutually agreeable settlement.

Confidentiality in Mediation:

Confidentiality is a cornerstone principle of mediation, promoting open and honest communication between the disputing parties. Confidentiality reassures participants that the information they share during the mediation process will not be disclosed to others or used against them in future legal proceedings. This fosters trust in the mediation process, enabling the parties to explore various options for resolution more candidly.

Conclusion:

Mediation is a powerful tool for resolving disputes in a peaceful and constructive manner. As an alternative to adversarial dispute resolution methods like litigation and arbitration, mediation presents a flexible, efficient, and cost-effective means of addressing conflicts in various domains. By leveraging the skills of a neutral mediator and adhering to the principles of voluntary participation and confidentiality, mediation empowers conflicting parties to collaborate in developing long-lasting, mutually beneficial resolutions. Mediation has the potential to transform the way conflicts are managed, thereby contributing to a more harmonious and just society.

Assistant: Title: International Legal Basis of Mediation and the Legislation of Uzbekistan: A Comparative Analysis

Annotation:
This article analyzes the international legal framework of mediation and compares it with the legislation of Uzbekistan. It provides an overview of the international conventions, principles, and practices related to mediation, with a focus on how Uzbekistan has adopted these provisions into its domestic legislation. The article discusses the benefits of aligning national mediation laws with international standards and the progress made by Uzbekistan in developing its mediation practices.

Introduction:

Mediation has gained recognition as an efficient and cost-effective alternative to traditional dispute resolution methods such as litigation and arbitration. At the international level, countries and organizations have pursued the development of legal instruments and standards to support and promote the use of mediation. Meanwhile, national legislation within countries like Uzbekistan has also recognized the potential of mediation, working to integrate international principles and practices into domestic laws. This article presents a comparative analysis of the international legal basis of mediation and the legislation of Uzbekistan on this matter.

International Legal Basis of Mediation:

Several international conventions, agreements, model laws, and guidelines contribute to the legal framework of mediation. Some of the most significant instruments include:

1. The United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation, known as the Singapore Convention on Mediation (2018) – This Convention aims to facilitate the enforcement of international mediated settlement agreements and to encourage the use of mediation in resolving cross-border commercial disputes.

2. The UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Conciliation (2002) - This Model Law provides procedural guidelines for resolving international commercial disputes through conciliation, a process similar to mediation.

3. The European Union Directive 2008/52/EC on Certain Aspects of Mediation in Civil and Commercial Matters – This Directive encourages the use of mediation in civil and commercial disputes within the European Union, establishing principles and minimum standards for mediations.

4. International Mediation Institute (IMI) Standards – The IMI, a non-profit organization, has established certification standards, guidelines, and ethical codes for mediators to ensure the quality, credibility, and professionalism of mediation services worldwide.

The Legislation of Uzbekistan on Mediation:

Recognizing the benefits of mediation, Uzbekistan has adopted various laws and regulations that incorporate international mediation principles and provide a legal framework for the practice of mediation in the country, such as:

1. The Law on Mediation (2020) - This law sets the legal foundation for mediation in Uzbekistan, establishing principles, conditions, and procedures for conducting mediation, along with defining the rights and responsibilities of mediators.

2. The Civil Procedure Code and the Code on Administrative Procedure - These codes include provisions for using mediation during court proceedings, referring disputes to mediation, and implementing mediation agreements.

3. Specific laws in various fields (e.g., labor, family, bankruptcy) - Uzbekistan has implemented mediation provisions in a range of sector-specific legislation, encouraging the use of mediation in diverse disputes.

4. Regulations governing the training, certification, and assessment of mediators, as well as the establishment of mediation centers within the Chambers of Commerce and Industry – These regulations ensure the quality and credibility of mediation services in Uzbekistan.

Benefits of Aligning National Legislation with International Standards:

Adopting international standards and principles of mediation within national legislation provides numerous advantages, including:

1. Universal recognition and enforceability – Aligning national mediation laws with international standards helps ensure that mediated settlement agreements receive recognition and enforcement both domestically and internationally.

2. Professionalism and credibility – Implementing internationally recognized mediator training, certification, and ethical standards promotes professionalism and credibility in the mediation process, increasing confidence in the practice.

3. Encouraging foreign investment – By adopting an internationally recognized mediation framework, countries like Uzbekistan can signal to foreign investors that they are committed to providing a supportive and efficient environment for resolving disputes, thereby attracting investments.

Progress in Uzbekistan:

Uzbekistan has made significant strides in recognizing the value of mediation and implementing a comprehensive legal framework to support its use. I recently visited a high school English class full of very bright kids. Since it
was the penultimate day on which they would ever be high school kids, they
were also very happy, but that’s another story. We spent an hour together talking
about Katherine Mansfield and Shakespeare and the avalanche of Jane Austen
films, sequels, prequels, and jonquils, and toward the end Dickens came up. The
teacher mentioned that they had read Great Expectations, so I asked, less than
naively, “Well, what did you think?” And being bright, motivated kids who
know the expected answer, they said, more or less convincingly, “It was good.”
Some used “really” in their sentence, but they all generally agreed. All but one.
The class curmudgeon said it wasn’t all that great and didn’t move him deeply. I
liked him better immediately. It takes courage, even on your next-to-last day of
high school, to say you’re in AP English and aren’t wild about one of the
established classics. For one thing, there’s the weight of more than a century of
received opinion going against you. And in this case the wild popularity of those
novels in the author’s own lifetime. Clearly, this kid was swimming against the
literary current. And that’s fine. We can’t all like the same books, the same films,
the same songs, despite what mass-marketing and American Idol might have us
believe. Or even the same things about said books, films, and songs.
Anyway, as I was driving back home past newly planted cornfields and
construction zones, his response made me think back on my own encounters
with Great Expectations. How did I feel about it? How do I feel about it now?
Let me preface this by saying that it has been nearly forty years, so I may not
accurately recall everything about that first reading. I remember clearly, though,
two things in particular: a sense of confusion early on, both in Pip’s encounter
with the escaped Magwitch and in his domestic arrangement with his sister and
her husband, and outrage at the ending. The first, I subsequently learned, is fairly
typical of the opening gambits in Dickens’s novels, and nowhere near the
murkiness and fog in the Court of Chancery at the outset of Bleak House. That
second one, though, that’s another story. Ruined the novel for me. No kidding—
absolutely ruined it. It was abrupt, suspiciously so. False. Insincere. Hokey. And
just plain dumb. So what was it that triggered this venom? Merely this.
I took her hand in mine, and we went out of the ruined place; and, as the
morning mists had risen long ago when I first left the forge, so, the
evening mists were rising now, and in all the broad expanse of tranquil
light they showed to me, I saw no shadow of another parting from her.
Even allowing for some changes in sensibility between 1861, the year of the
novel’s publication, and 1969, the year of my encounter with it, this was just
wrong. Had Pip learned nothing through all his suffering? Could he not see that
happiness was never possible with Estella, no matter how much she had been
changed by her own experiences? Didn’t he have at least a shred of pride? And
et cetera.
In case you don’t know the story, here’s the gist: Pip had once been engaged
as a playmate and companion for Estella by an ancient harridan named Miss
Havisham, who saw the young girl as her instrument for wreaking vengeance on
the male sex for having stood her up at the marriage altar (she lives out her days
in her wedding dress amid the wreckage of the aborted reception feast). Pip,
although neither knows it, is Estella’s practice victim, the boy on whom she can
perfect cruelty. She gets rather good at it. Of course they meet later in life, of
course she leads him on but marries another, of course he’s a fool of the first
order to believe that he loves her, much less the reverse; otherwise, there’s no
need for this famous final scene. Then, after much misery on both sides, they
just happen (of all Dickens’s contrivances, one of the most contrived) to meet at
the burnt-out ruins of Miss Havisham’s mansion. Some cursory apologies are
exchanged, but nothing momentous enough to prepare for the hearts-and-violins
ending. So naturally, my future self was appalled. Some of it, I suppose, had to
do with being a teenaged male who took rejection by girls about as badly as the
next guy. If memory serves, I was also what could generously be called
“between girlfriends.” In fact, fairly far between. Part of it had to do with having
plodded through several hundred pages of hard going, only to have them
trivialized by this “easy” ending, as I saw it. Maybe that’s what my reading
always is, some combination of testosterone, life history, insecurity, male ego,
aesthetic judgment, and gut sense (or nonsense). Hard to judge from the inside.
In any case, that’s what I felt at the time.
But there was one more thing that I felt about that ending but couldn’t have
defended: Dickens didn’t believe it, either. It was an idea. A belief. A conviction.
With nothing whatsoever to back it up.

Les résultats obtenus ont démontré une activité antioxydante modérée, grâce à la valeur IC50. Cette évaluation est confirmée par la valeur AAI =1,29, mettant en évidence le potentiel antioxydant remarquable de l’extrait. En comparaison, la vitamine C utilisée comme antioxydant de référence, a présenté une activité supérieure avec une valeur IC50 inferieur que celle du l’extrait et une valeur AAI très élevé. Concernant la teneur totale en polyphénols, des résultats détaillés fourniront des informations sur la concentration de polyphénols présents contribuant à son activité antioxydante.
Cette étude met en évidence le remarquable potentiel antioxydant de l’extrait, offrant une connaissance précieuse pour l’utilisation de cette plante médicinale en tant que source naturelle d’antioxydants. Les implications de ces résultats s’étendent au développement de produits pharmaceutiques, nutraceutiques et alimentaires dotés de propriétés antioxydantes améliorées.
 Mots clés: activité antioxydante, test DPPH, teneur totale en polyphénols, réactif Folin-Ciocalteu, Trigonella foenum graecum. L, extrait des graines.

元类是一种特殊的类，被用来动态地创建类定义，而描述符（Descriptor）则是一种属性访问控制机制。在Django中，模型定义时会使用元类，而每个字段则使用描述符类进行管理。

元类通过实现`__new__`方法来动态地创建模型类的定义。当模型类定义时，元类会读取定义的属性数据，并根据其类型和选项来创建描述符类和字段属性，然后将它们赋值给模型类。这样，当模型类实例化时，就会根据定义的字段来创建数据库表格，并自动关联到模型类的实例上，实现了Python类和数据库之间的一一对应映射。

例如，定义一个模型类Person，其中有两个字段name和age：

```python
from django.db import models

class Person(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=30)
    age = models.IntegerField()
```

当我们运行makemigrations和migrate命令时，Django就会自动将这个模型类映射到数据库表格中，创建相应的name和age字段。

总之，Django通过元类和描述符的技术来实现Python类和数据库之间的映射，从而实现了ORM的功能。

Плюсы создания велодорожек

1. Экология: Велодорожки способствуют сокращению количества автомобилей на дорогах, что ведет к уменьшению выбросов углекислого газа и других вредных веществ. Это благоприятно сказывается на качестве воздуха в городах и здоровье горожан.
