Assistant: No Brasil, o incômodo causado por festas públicas é um tema regulamentado por diversas leis e normas, envolvendo desde legislações ambientais até o Código Civil, passando por normativas municipais específicas sobre o controle do uso de espaços públicos e sobre poluição sonora.

### Legislação Aplicável:

1. **Lei Federal nº 9.605/1998 (Lei dos Crimes Ambientais):** Esta lei tipifica como crime a conduta de causar poluição de qualquer natureza em níveis tais que resultem ou possam resultar em danos à saúde humana ou que provoquem a mortandade de animais ou a destruição significativa da flora. A poluição sonora causada por festas públicas excessivamente barulhentas pode ser enquadrada nesta lei.
   
2. **Código Civil (Lei nº 10.406/2002):** Especificamente nos artigos que tratam dos direitos de vizinhança, o Código Civil dispõe sobre a obrigação de o proprietário ou possuidor de um bem não usar esse bem de maneira a causar prejuízo à saúde, sossego e segurança dos que se encontram ao seu redor.

3. **Leis Municipais e Decretos Locais:** Muitos municípios possuem regulamentação própria relativa ao controle de ruídos e à realização de eventos. Essas normas definem os limites aceitáveis de emissão de ruídos, horários permitidos para a realização de eventos em espaços públicos, além de estabelecer a necessidade de autorizações para tais atividades.

4. **Norma Brasileira (NBR) da ABNT:** As normas técnicas da Associação Brasileira de Normas Técnicas (ABNT) também são relevantes, especificamente a NBR 10151, voltadas para a avaliação do ruído em áreas habitadas, visando o conforto da comunidade.

### Medidas Legais:

- **Notificação por Perturbação ao Sossego:** Quando as festas públicas excedem os limites legais de ruído ou se estendem por horários não permitidos pela legislação local, os cidadãos podem acionar os órgãos de segurança pública para interceder, baseando-se principalmente na perturbação do sossego alheio.

- **Ações Judiciais:** Dependendo do caso, pode-se recorrer à justiça para buscar reparação por danos causados pelas festas, sejam eles morais ou materiais, além de solicitar medidas preventivas para futuras ocorrências.

### Conclusão:

O direito ao sossego e ao descanso é protegido por variadas leis brasileiras. Enquanto a realização de eventos em locais públicos é uma prática comum e culturalmente significativa, existe um claro limite imposto pela legislação para assegurar que tais atividades não prejudiquem o bem-estar da população. Ação da comunidade, aliada à aplicação efetiva da legislação, desempenha um papel crucial na manutenção do equilíbrio entre a celebração de festas públicas e o respeito ao direito ao sossego.

L’utilisation des techniques de Machine Learning, et plus particulièrement des réseaux de neurones convolutifs (Convolutional Neural Networks, CNN), pour la prédiction et la détection du cancer du sein a montré des résultats prometteurs. Lorsque vous abordez une étude sur la prédiction du cancer du sein en utilisant un modèle CNN, plusieurs concepts clés et étapes sont nécessaires. Voici les concepts pertinents que vous pourriez rencontrer dans une telle étude :

1. **Data Mining (Exploration des données)** : L’exploration des données médicales pour détecter des motifs et des tendances qui peuvent être utilisés pour le diagnostic du cancer du sein. Cela peut inclure l'analyse de mammographies, de données histopathologiques, ou d'autres types de données d'imagerie.

2. **Prétraitement des données** : Avant que les données d’imagerie ne puissent être utilisées pour entraîner un modèle CNN, elles doivent subir une série de traitements tels que la normalisation, la remise à l'échelle, et parfois l'augmentation des données, pour améliorer la performance du modèle.

3. **Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)** : Les CNN sont une classe de réseaux de neurones artificiels profonds, spécialisés dans le traitement de données ayant une topologie en grille, comme les images. Les CNN sont connus pour leur capacité à détecter des caractéristiques dans les images à différents niveaux d’abstraction.

4. **Architecture de modèle CNN** : La conception d'un réseau CNN avec différentes couches: couches de convolution pour la détection des caractéristiques, couches d'activation telles que ReLU, couches de pooling pour réduire la dimensionnalité, et enfin les couches fully connected pour la classification.

5. **Fonction de perte (Loss Function)** : La fonction utilisée pour mesurer l’écart entre les prédictions du modèle et les véritables labels durant l'entraînement. La fonction de perte courante pour les problèmes de classification est l'entropie croisée.

6. **Optimisation et Backpropagation** : Le processus par lequel le modèle ajuste ses poids pour minimiser la fonction de perte. Des algorithmes comme Adam, SGD (Stochastic Gradient Descent), ou RMSprop sont souvent utilisés.

7. **Validation croisée** : Une technique pour évaluer la capacité généralisatrice du modèle en le testant sur des sous-ensembles distincts de données pour éviter le surajustement (overfitting).

8. **Surajustement et Sous-ajustement (Overfitting and Underfitting)** : Lorsque le modèle est trop complexe, il peut être trop ajusté aux données d'entraînement et ne pas bien se généraliser. À l’inverse, un modèle trop simple qui ne capture pas suffisamment la complexité des données peut être sous-ajusté.

9. **Métriques d'évaluation** : Les métriques comme la précision (accuracy), la sensibilité (recall), la spécificité, la valeur prédictive positive (precision), la valeur prédictive négative et la mesure F1 sont utilisées pour évaluer les performances du modèle.

10. **Trouver des régions d'intérêt (ROI)** : Pour la segmentation du cancer dans les images, le modèle CNN pourrait être entraîné pour identifier les régions d'intérêt où les anomalies sont plus susceptibles d'être présentes.

11. **Heatmaps et Class Activation Maps** : Des techniques pour visualiser les régions de l'image qui ont le plus contribué à la décision du modèle CNN, ce qui peut aider les médecins à comprendre la prédiction du modèle.

12. **Interprétabilité et Explicabilité** : Comprendre pourquoi et comment le modèle CNN prend certaines décisions est crucial pour la confiance dans le déploiement clinique de telles technologies.

En résumé, une étude sur la prédiction du cancer du sein en utilisant un modèle CNN impliquera le traitement des données d'image, la conception et l'entraînement d'un modèle CNN, suivis de l'évaluation de sa performance et de l'exploration de la capacité du modèle à interpréter les résultats pour une application clinique.

User: is a column-oriented DBMS more space efficient than row-oriented RDBMS for sparse fields?
Assistant: Yes, a column-oriented DBMS is generally more space-efficient than row-oriented RDBMS for sparse fields. In a columnar database, data is stored column by column instead of row by row. When you have sparse fields, i.e., fields with many missing or null values, columnar databases can take advantage of the similarities in the data by using compression techniques more effectively.

In a columnar database, it is possible to compress the significant number of null values into just a few bits, while in a row-oriented RDBMS null values would be stored in each row, which would consume more storage space. Additionally, columnar databases can use advanced compression techniques such as run-length encoding, dictionary encoding, and bit-packing, which result in significant storage savings, especially for sparse fields.

User: How can i fit into the team at work? I feel left out and like i don't bring anything to the team
Assistant: Feeling left out and thinking that you don't bring anything to the team can be disheartening, but there are several steps you can take to fit in and contribute effectively. Here are some suggestions:

1. Observe and understand the team dynamics: Take some time to observe how your team members interact, communicate, and collaborate. Understanding the team dynamics, roles, and relationships can help you identify where you can fit in.

2. Get to know your colleagues: Make an effort to socialize with your colleagues outside of work-related conversations. Initiating conversations, asking about their interests, hobbies, or weekend plans can help you bond with them on a personal level.

3. Communicate openly: Good communication is crucial for any team. Make sure to actively participate in team meetings, contribute your ideas and thoughts, and share your perspectives when appropriate. Also, actively listen to others and show support for their ideas.

4. Seek opportunities to contribute: Look for ways to add value to the team. Volunteer for tasks or projects that align with your skills and interests. By actively taking part in team activities, you can demonstrate your commitment and willingness to contribute.

5. Build your expertise: Identify areas where you can improve your knowledge or skills related to your job. By boosting your expertise, you'll feel more confident and valuable within the team. Consider attending relevant training sessions or seeking guidance from your teammates.

6. Find a mentor: If possible, seek guidance from a more experienced colleague who can offer advice and support. They can provide insights into team dynamics, help you navigate any challenges, and offer suggestions for improving your contributions.

7. Take initiative: Look for opportunities to take the lead on projects or propose new ideas. Be proactive and show that you're a motivated team player. By taking more responsibility, you'll be seen as an essential member of the team.

8. Stay positive and show enthusiasm: Maintain a positive attitude at work, even during challenging times. Show enthusiasm for team achievements and appreciate the contributions made by your teammates. Positive energy can help you integrate more easily into the team.

Remember, fitting into a team takes time, effort, and patience. Be persistent and continue seeking ways to contribute and develop relationships with your colleagues.

Yearender 2023: 7 trends that ruled tech industry in 2023
2023 was jam-packed with tech upgrades, Elon Musk drama, and the rise of scams. Simple tech talk, leaving us curious about what's next.
Written By: Vishal Upadhyay
New Delhi
Updated on: December 23, 2023 18:03 IST
URL copied
Follow us on
Image Source : FILE Representational Image
2023 will be remembered as the year when Artificial Intelligence took centre stage. Beyond AI, various tech innovations and controversies stirred the tech landscape. Elon Musk's presence was constant, and the emergence of new AI models seemed almost weekly. Let's delve into the seven trends that shaped the Indian tech industry.
Artificial In The Spotlight
2023 will be remembered as the year when Artificial Intelligence took centre stage, showcasing robots creating art that baffled critics and AI assistants crafting haikus on demand. Major tech companies invested heavily in AI, setting the stage for its even grander growth in 2024.
ChatGPT vs. Bard - The AI Battle
OpenAI's ChatGPT became a household name in generative AI. With millions of users, it's growing smarter each day. Google entered the game with Bard, trying to catch up. Who'll reign supreme in 2024? The debate continues.
Deepfake Drama
Though not a new threat, deepfakes gained prominence in 2023, especially with Indian celebrities falling victim. As we head into the election year of 2024, the deepfake saga might not be over yet.
Elon Musk: The Unavoidable Figure
Elon Musk, with his tweets, controversies, and unmistakable presence, dominated tech discussions. Twitter, once a lively hub for news and memes, transformed mysteriously, bidding farewell to its familiar blue logo and name, Musk rebranded Twitter as X.
Vision Pro - Apple's Game-changing Move
In 2023, Apple unveiled Vision Pro, a mixed-reality headset promising a revolutionary spatial computing experience. The question remains: Will people embrace this game-changing gadget, or is it just an impressive tech piece?
Type-C Takes Over
Grudgingly pushed by the EU, Apple transitioned to Type-C for iPhones in 2023, including the AirPods Pro. As we look ahead to 2024, the lightning port may bid farewell to all Apple products.

As more people embrace digital life, online scams surged in 2023. From UPI to courier scams, cybercrime soared. Vigilance became paramount to avoid falling victim to scams in this increasingly digital landscape.

User: What is the environment poverty nexus?
Assistant: The environment-poverty nexus refers to the interdependence and complex relationship between environmental degradation and poverty. It recognizes that environmental issues, such as climate change, deforestation, water scarcity, and pollution, can contribute to the persistence of poverty, while poverty can also drive overexploitation of natural resources and worsen environmental degradation.

On one hand, environmental degradation can lead to increased poverty by diminishing access to resources, reducing agricultural productivity, increasing the frequency and intensity of natural disasters, and damaging ecosystems that provide essential services like clean water or natural buffering against climate change impacts.

On the other hand, poverty can exacerbate environmental degradation as people living in poverty may resort to unsustainable practices like illegal logging, overfishing, or unsustainable farming methods to meet their immediate needs. Lack of resources, education, and technology can limit the adoption of environmentally friendly practices, leading to a vicious cycle of poverty and environmental degradation.

Addressing the environment-poverty nexus requires integrated and holistic approaches that simultaneously aim to reduce poverty and promote sustainable environmental practices. This may involve initiatives like sustainable agriculture, renewable energy solutions, improving access to education and healthcare, empowering local communities, and ensuring equitable distribution of resources and benefits.

While some agreed that individual decisions could influence poverty, others contested this viewpoint. However, a particular question from my LinkedIn network gave me pause: Can donors truly make a difference in alleviating poverty?
While donor funds have undeniably contributed to development, it's time for Africa to consider harnessing its own resources for sustainable progress.
In the realm of economic literature, McGillivray's comprehensive review underscores the undeniable role of aid in promoting economic growth and reducing poverty. This trend generally holds across diverse countries. Nonetheless, the reduction in aid to sub-Saharan Africa and the Pacific regions during the 1990s has been directly linked to the surge in poverty levels in these regions. This paradox emphasizes the complex relationship between aid and self-sufficiency.
Andre Shleifer's exploration of foreign aid's evolution paints a nuanced picture. While some critics have argued that foreign aid has failed since the 1970s, Shleifer's perspective highlights the need to recalibrate the aid framework rather than outright dismissal. Shleifer posits three pivotal shifts in perception. First, the response to the failure to recognize aid's benefits is not a reduction but an increase in spending. Shleifer argues that the inadequacy of the expenditure, rather than the lack of benefit, is to blame for the struggle to identify positive outcomes.
Second, the traditional focus on economic growth as the primary goal of foreign aid is reimagined. Shleifer suggests that poverty alleviation should take centre stage, given its advantages regarding donor accountability—this reframing positions foreign assistance as a significant welfare program for the developing world. Finally, the foundation of continued foreign aid hinges not solely on evidence of its effectiveness but also on cultivating empathy among Western taxpayers. This shift toward public relations as a cornerstone of foreign aid underscores the evolving dynamics of aid distribution.
However, a significant counterargument surfaces against continued reliance on foreign aid for Africa's development. Critics contend that aid can inadvertently perpetuate dependency and hinder the continent's pursuit of self-reliance. The essence of African independence and empowerment is compromised when external resources dominate their development landscape. This perspective resonates with those advocating for decolonization within African academia.
The notion that "There ain't no such thing as a free lunch" encapsulates Africa's predicament accurately. The lure of external aid often comes with underlying expectations, strings attached that may erode the sovereignty and autonomy of African nations. The narrative that Africa must transition from aid dependence to self-sufficiency is gaining momentum as scholars and policymakers seek ways to break the cycle of dependency.
So, how can Africa chart a new course towards prosperity? The answer lies in strategic resource management, investment in human capital, and nurturing homegrown industries. Africa boasts abundant natural and human resources, which can drive sustainable development if harnessed efficiently. From fostering entrepreneurship to enhancing education and innovation, the continent has the potential to shape its destiny on its terms.
Africa's discourse on poverty and foreign aid remains complex and debatable. While donor aid has positively impacted development, there is a growing consensus that Africa's path to true prosperity must involve a shift towards self-reliance. Shleifer's insights suggest that a redefined approach to aid centred around poverty alleviation and aided by public relations efforts could be a stepping stone in this journey. Yet, the pressing need for African nations to prioritize their autonomy, break free from aid-driven dependency, and seize control of their development trajectory stands as an imperative task for the continent. As Africa confronts its challenges and capitalizes on its potential, a future where self-generated and sustained prosperity is both an aspiration and a reality within reach.

Technical Details
The project is comprised in four different modules/components:
Statistical report as a new CLI-option
This component involves building an additional CLI module to cooltools and its respective library module, inspired by this current issue: https://github.com/open2c/cooltools/issues/415. The main idea of this component is to calculate and report comprehensive statistics for any .cool file. The associated stats comprise the number of contact points across regions (cis/trans), fraction of contacts within and between regions, distance decay of contacts, among others, that could be restrained to a specific region(s) or chromosome(s) specified by the user. This component will offer easier parallelization strategies achieved by PyO3 and Rust modules to make it faster and easier to implement. The module will be called “coolstats.py” and will use the current dependencies cooltools uses to parse command-line arguments (click). Additionally, will construct similar classes as seen in pairtools, another software produce by the Open2C team, with similar structures (e.g. CoolCounter class) and functions. However, to preserve independence and a better organization, each metric will have its own function. The proposed output is a .txt file with the organized stats and additional plots representing those results saved to the current directory by default or any directory the user specifies with the flag -d/–dir. Other types of formats or the specific layout will be discussed with the team.
CLI-related functionality corrections
Solve current issues related to the CLI behavior, such as smoothing and aggregation across regions in get_expected_cis() or dropping headers for fetch_chromsizes(), and also implement alternate reductions for aggregation across diagonals, such as variance or standard deviation, adding new arguments to control these features preserving the current functionality as default. These changes can be achieved with the current code and without any extra dependencies. Furthermore, this component will be implemented with its respective documentation following the current guidelines of Open2C and unit tests to ensure the viability of the software.
Refactoring of current structures
Using the initial ideas from here: https://github.com/open2c/cooltools/issues/227 and here https://github.com/open2c/cooltools/issues/502, I plan to implement a new class for snipper (called Snipper) and re-use the current methods attached. Additional modifications will be added to enhance the functionality and solve current issues, such as decoupling selecting and snipping methods (e.g. snipper.select() and snipper.snip()) and converting bed-like inputs to 2D structures (e.g. bedpe) to reduce overheading over subsequent conversions. As part of this refactoring, I also plan to create a separate mini-repository to store log-smoothing-related functions that will be used not only by cooltools but the whole Open2C ecosystem. The basic functionality of the latter will comprise operating over the core cooltools structures (e.g. numpy arrays and pandas dataframes) with flexibility on column names. 
Rust-based acceleration of core modules and polars as an efficient alternative
Based on a current issue, some parts of cooltools can improve by parallelization strategies, as seen here: https://github.com/open2c/cooltools/commit/c6b705d7aac895006efe797cb22da332793a7ae2#commitcomment-84603046, for example. As mentioned in the first component here, using PyO3 and Rust could be of great advantage. Here, a function called “send_chunk()” will receive a subset of the Hi-C contact matrix that corresponds to a specific genomic region and the parameters to perform the calculations in parallel using the rayon crate.
On the other hand, I propose to explore the possibility of using the polars package, a query engine for dataframes natively multi-threaded, to perform dataframe calculations currently done using pandas. Since polars have demonstrated to be way faster than pandas in tasks related to querying, grouping or sorting (see https://medium.com/cuenex/pandas-2-0-vs-polars-the-ultimate-battle-a378eb75d6d1), and also considering that polars can accept pandas dataframes as inputs, benchmarking current cooltools operations using polars instead of pandas could potentially lead to significant advantages. I plan to apply this proposal first to functions using “sort_values()” and benchmark them against the current implementation.  This also could be applied to other Open2C tools, such as bioframe, within the sort_bedframe() function.

Ее каштановые волосы длиной до плеч аккуратно уложены, на ней элегантное темно-синее платье, в руке она сжимает блокнот. Внезапно она получает сообщение о том, что в город прибыл таинственный незнакомец.

Линда: (взволнованно) По-видимому, в Блейкстоне появилась странная фигура, и у него, похоже, особый интерес к нашему городу. Кто он? Какие секреты он скрывает? Чего он хочет? Я не успокоюсь, пока не найду ответы на эти вопросы!

Линда выслеживает незнакомца в маленьком кафе в центре города. Она входит в кафе с решительным видом, держа в руке диктофон. Внутри она замечает новоприбывшего, одиноко сидящего у окна. Тускло освещенное кафе и негромкая джазовая музыка создают вокруг него атмосферу таинственности. Он выглядит как хорошо одетый, сдержанный джентльмен, потягивающий кофе, но в его поведении есть что-то потустороннее. Он называет себя “Фикшор”. Линда осторожно подходит к нему, представляясь и заявляя о своем намерении узнать о нем побольше.

Фикксор: (с намеком на улыбку) Моя дорогая мисс Мартин, я не более чем скромный исследователь, специализирующийся на древних фолиантах и артефактах. Я приехал в Блейкстон, чтобы изучить редкую книгу, которая, как полагают, спрятана в этом городе, и которая содержит глубокую мудрость, которая была давно забыта.

Акт III: Раскрыта темная цель

Линда продолжает расследовать дело Фикксора, отмечая, что его присутствие совпадает с загадочным ростом заболеваемости среди пожилого населения города. Обеспокоенное выражение появляется на ее лице, когда она раскрывает тайну Фикксора в ходе своего расследования. Он использует человеческие слабости, такие как зависимость от сахара и распространенные болезни, чтобы извлечь жизненную силу из пожилых людей, намереваясь возродить “Книгу о шести углах” Х.П. Лавкрафта. Линда, ошеломленная этим откровением, знает, что должна остановить его, несмотря на риск.

Акт IV: Битва умов

Присутствие полицейских сирен и мигающих красных и синих огней возле городской библиотеки создает сцену паники, когда Линда рассказывает Фикссору о его коварном плане. Над головой кружат вертолеты, а узкие переулки отбрасывают резкие тени на великолепное здание библиотеки. Они оба вступают в ожесточенный спор, пока Линда пытается помешать его планам и привлечь его к ответственности.

Фикксор: (рычит) Вы не можете постичь знания, содержащиеся в этой книге, мисс Мартин! Неужели ты думаешь, что сможешь помешать моей цели, будучи на столетия старше тебя?

Линда: (неустрашимо) Может, я и всего лишь человек, но дух справедливости - это сила, намного более могущественная, чем любое потустороннее существо. У вас ничего не получится!

Акт V: Торжество справедливости

Непоколебимое мужество и решимость Линды в конечном счете пересиливают темную волю Фикксора. Она выхватывает книгу у него из рук как раз в тот момент, когда к нему приближается полиция. Позже она с триумфом наблюдает, как власти арестовывают Фикшора и увозят его.

Линда стоит на теперь уже мирной городской площади, ее грудь тяжело вздымается после перенесенного испытания. Она прижимает “Книгу о шести углах” к груди, зная, что в ней в равной мере содержатся свет и тьма. С большой силой приходит большая ответственность, и Линда теперь является хранительницей этого знания.

Когда заходящее солнце освещает заключительную сцену, становится ясно, что Линда Мартин остановила великое зло, обрушившееся на мир. Ее храбрость, ум и неустанное стремление к справедливости спасли город Блейкстон от мрачной судьбы. Камера уменьшает масштаб, и экран становится черным.

Researchers Accurately Simulate 100 Million Atoms With Machine Learning
May 22, 2023 by Brian Wang
Harvard researchers bring the accuracy, sample efficiency, and robustness of deep equivariant neural networks to the simulate 44 million atoms. This is achieved through a combination of innovative model architecture, massive parallelization, and models and implementations optimized for efficient GPU utilization. The resulting Allegro architecture bridges the accuracy speed tradeoff of atomistic simulations and enables description of dynamics in structures of unprecedented complexity at quantum fidelity. To illustrate the scalability of Allegro, they perform nanoseconds-long stable simulations of protein dynamics and scale up to a 44-million atom structure of a complete, all-atom, explicitly solvated HIV capsid on the Perlmutter supercomputer. They demonstrate excellent strong scaling up to 100 million atoms and 70% weak scaling to 5120 A100 GPUs.

This is the first scalable, transferable machine-learning potential with state-of-the-art equivariant deep-learning accuracy. Performance of 100 timesteps/s for range of biomolecular systems. 70% weak scaling to 1280 nodes and 5120 A100 GPUs, excellent strong scaling up to 100 million atoms. First application of state-of-the-art machine learning interatomic potentials to large-scale biomolecular simulations.




Problem Overview: First-Principles Dynamics of Matter
The ability to predict the time evolution of matter on the atomic scale is the foundation of modern computational biology, chemistry, and materials engineering. Even as quantum mechanics governs the microscopic atom-electron interactions in vibrations, migration and bond dissociation, phenomena governing observable physical and chemical processes often occur at much larger length- and longer time-scales than
those of atomic motion. Bridging these scales requires both innovation in fast and highly accurate computational approaches capturing the quantum interactions and in extremely parallelizable architectures able to access exascale computers.

Presently, realistic physical and chemical systems are far more structurally complex than what computational methods are capable of investigating, and their observable evolution is beyond the timescales of atomistic simulations. This gap between key fundamental questions and phenomena that can be effectively modeled has persisted for decades. From one side of the gap, models of small size, representing ostensibly important parts of the systems, can be constructed and investigated with highfidelity computationally expensive models, such as electronic structure methods of density functional theory (DFT) and wave-function quantum chemistry. In the domain of materials science, these models can capture individual interfaces in metallic composites, defects in semiconductors, and flat surfaces of catalysts. However, evolution of such structures over relevant time scales is out of reach with electronic structure methods. Importantly, such reduction of complexity
is not possible in the domain of biological sciences, where entire structures of viruses consist of millions of atoms, in addition to similarly large number of explicit water molecules needed to capture the physiological environment. From the other side of the gap, uncontrolled approximations have to be made to reach large sizes and sufficient computational speeds. These approximations have relied on very simple analytical models for interatomic interactions and have many documented failures of describing dynamics of both complex
inorganic and biological materials.

Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are a pillar of computational science, enabling insights into the dynamics of molecules and materials at the atomic scale. MD provides a level of resolution, understanding, and control that experiments often cannot provide, thereby serving as an extremely powerful tool to advance our unstanding and design of novel molecules and materials. Molecular dynamics simulates the time evolution of atoms according to Newton’s equations of motion. By integrating the forces at each time step, a sequence of many-atom configurations is obtained, from which physical observables can then be obtained.

The bottleneck of MD is the short integration time step required, which usually lies on the order of femtoseconds. Since many chemical and biological processes occur on the timescale of microseconds or even milliseconds, billions to trillions of integration steps are needed. This highlights the requirement common to all MD simulation for access to atomic forces in a way that is simultaneously both a) accurate and b) computationally efficient.

For decades, two different avenues have been pursued: on one hand, classical force-fields (FFs) are able to simulate large-scale systems with
high computational efficiency, enabling simulations of billions of atoms and reaching even microsecond simulation timescales on special-purpose hardware The simple functional form of classical FFs, however, greatly limits their predictive power and results in them not being able to capture quantum mechanical effects or complex chemical transformations. On the other hand, quantum-mechanical simulations provide a
highly accurate description of the electronic structure of molecules and materials. Interatomic forces computed with these first-principles methods can then be used to integrate the atoms in molecular dynamics, called ab-initio molecular dynamics (AIMD), with DFT being the most common method of choice. The cubic scaling of plane-wave DFT with the number of electrons, however, is the key bottleneck limiting AIMD simulations as it severely limits both length- and timescales of AIMD simulations, only allowing thousands of atoms and hundreds of picoseconds in routine simulations.

Current State of the Art: Accuracy

Over the past two decades, machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have been pursued with immense interest as a third approach, promising to bypass this long-standing dilemma. The aim of MLIPs is to learn energies and forces from high-accuracy reference data
while scaling linearly with the number of atoms. Initial efforts combined hand-crafted descriptors with a Gaussian Process or a shallow neural network. These first MLIPs were quickly further improved and have been adapted to biomolecular simulations, trained on large data sets to
provide general-purpose potentials. Despite this initial progress, however, this first generation of MLIPs has been severely limited in predictive accuracy, often unable to generalize to structures different from those in the training data, resulting in simulations that are not transferable and often not robust. In an effort to overcome these limitations in accuracy, more recently, deep learning interatomic potentials based on the message passing neural network (MPNN) paradigm have been proposed and shown to be a more accurate alternative to the first generation of MLIPs, however at a significant computational overhead.

Common to all interatomic potentials is a focus on symmetry: in particular, the energy must obey invariance with respect to translations, rotations, and reflections, which together comprise E(3), the Euclidean group in 3D. Both classical forcefields and modern MLIPs achieve this by only ever acting on geometric invariants of the underlying structures. More recently, in an attempt to better represent the symmetry of the data, invariant interatomic potentials have been generalized to equivariant ones. In equivariant MLIPs, the hidden network features consist of not only scalar features, but also vectors and higher-order tensors, resulting in a more faithful representation of the atomistic geometry.

The initial NequIP work on equivariant interatomic potentials demonstrated not only a step change in state-of-theart accuracy, but also the ability to outperform the invariant DeepMD accuracy while training on a thousand times smaller data set. Following these efforts, equivariant MLIPs have been shown to greatly improve stability of simulations and display much better extrapolative power than existing approaches. Equivariant potentials however, struggle with scale and speed since all existing methods combine the equivariance with the MPNN architecture of previous generation methods. This is due to the graph propagation mechanism in MPNNs: at each layer of message passing, information is passed from a central node to its neighbors. The best system has achieved a 20,894 atom simulation.

In order to scale a message passing network, one would have to either maintain enormous neighbor lists, or transfer messages and gradients between devices at each layer. Both of these approaches are destined to be slow, with the latter also requiring extensive software development to allow the neural network’s message passing to work together with the MD software’s spatial decomposition message passing. Thus the exceptional accuracy of equivariant methods remains inaccessible for applications that require large length scales and long timescale simulations, with biological systems being a major example that is virtually entirely excluded from these state-of-the-art approaches.

Current State of the Art: Scalability and speed

In parallel to the improvements in accuracy, great strides have been achieved in terms of the computational cost of MLIPs, with several methods sacrificing some accuracy in order to be able to perform extreme-scale simulations. Most notably, the DeePMD method won the 2020 Gordon Bell supercomputing award for their 100 million-atom simulations, using the entire Summit machine.

SNAP extended the scale to 20 billion atoms, accompanied by a 20-fold increase in speed. Finally, FLARE set the current record for GPU-accelerated MLIP uncertainty-aware reactive MD benchmarks with 0.5 trillion atoms on Summit and a 70% speed increase over SNAP.

Allegro: Scalable Equivariant Deep Learning

Allegro is the first scalable equivariant MLIP to overcome the previous dilemma of choosing between highly accurate, robust, transferable equivariant models and scalable, but less accurate, first-generation models. Allegro attains this by first decomposing the total predicted energy of the system into atomic energies.

The first key innovation of Allegro is its tensor product layer, which updates the features with information about neighboring atoms’ geometry using the “tensor product of representations,” a fundamental equivariant operation. Specifically, the perordered-pair tensor features are updated by taking their tensor product with a learned weighted sum over the spherical harmonic embeddings of the positions of the neighbors of the central atom.

This innovation allows Allegro to learn increasingly complex representations of the atomic structure layer after layer while keeping all interactions strictly local, thus making it massively parallelizable.

The second central innovation of Allegro is motivated by the difference in cost between scalar operations and the much more expensive 𝑂(3)-equivariant operations that are symmetrically permitted on tensors. Allegro is therefore designed to put significant network capacity into the scalar operations, particularly dense neural networks, which are comparatively cheap and highly optimized on modern GPU hardware, while keeping as few expensive equivariant operations as possible (only the tensor product) and limiting the number of tensor feature channels.

This is achieved by having separate scalar and tensor tracks throughout the network, which at each layer communicate information which allows the high capacity of the scalar track to “control” the equivariant features. Across deep learning, it has repeatedly been observed that larger networks perform better. In high-performance applications of deep learning such as interatomic potentials, however, this increase in computation is unsustainable as it would hurt computational efficiency. The ability of Allegro to partially decouple these two effects allows it to greatly increase network capacity while keeping the computational overhead moderate.

Allegro outperforms state-of-the-art potentials on energies and forces of small molecules as measured by the QM9 and revMD17 benchmarks, including state-of-the-art equivariant message-passing-based approaches. Remarkably, Allegro also performs significantly better than the DeepMD potential on water despite being trained on more than 1,000 times fewer reference data. This demonstrates that Allegro is able to retain the remarkable improvements demonstrated by equivariant message-passing potentials, while being massively parallelizable, greatly increasing accessible length-scales as well as time-to-solution.

The work demonstrates the advantages of high-capacity equivariant Allegro models in accurately learning forces across the entire SPICE dataset of over 1 million structures of drug-like molecules and peptides. This data scale implies the promise of learning the entire sets of inorganic materials and organic molecules far more accurately than previously attempted, which would open the prospects of fast exascale simulations of unprecedentedly wide ranges of materials systems.

Recently they demonstrated that it is possible to efficiently quantify uncertainty of deep equivariant model predictions of forces and energies and use it to perform active learning for automatic construction of training sets. Natural adaptation of Gaussian mixture models in Allegro will open the possibility of large-scale uncertainty-aware simulations using a single model, as opposed to ensembles.

Finally, the major implication of the demonstrated accuracy of equivariant models is the urgent need to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the quantum electron structure calculations that are used as reference to train MLIPs, as this now becomes the major accuracy bottleneck in computational chemistry, biology and materials science.

Assistant: Portrait photography, with its focus on capturing the essence, personality, and mood of a person, requires a blend of technical skills, creative vision, and interpersonal acumen. Here’s a rundown of the most crucial concepts and techniques, alongside insights from famous photographers who have mastered the art.

### Fundamental Concepts and Techniques

1. **Understanding Light:** The essence of photography is light. The direction, quality, and quantity of light significantly affect the mood and look of the portrait. Soft, diffused light is flattering for most subjects, whereas harsh, direct light can create a more dramatic effect.
   - **Annie Leibovitz** is renowned for her masterful use of lighting. Her work often features a careful balance between ambient and artificial light, crafting iconic portraits that feel intimate yet grand.

2. **Composition:** How a portrait is framed and composed can drastically affect its impact. The rule of thirds, leading lines, and the use of negative space are just a few compositional techniques that can enhance a portrait.
   - **Steve McCurry**, famous for the “Afghan Girl,” demonstrates exceptional use of composition, often framing his subjects in a way that tells a story and captures the essence of their environment and culture.

3. **Choosing the Right Lens:** The choice of lens affects the portrait’s perspective. A common lens for portrait photography is the 85mm on a full-frame camera, as it provides a flattering perspective without distorting facial features. Wider lenses might be used for environmental portraits, and longer lenses can create a more intimate feel.
   - **Henri Cartier-Bresson** often used a 50mm lens for its natural perspective, capturing candid portraits that felt as if they were a slice of real life.

4. **Depth of Field:** Using a shallow depth of field (a wide aperture) helps to isolate the subject from the background, putting the focus squarely on them. This technique is particularly effective in making the subject stand out.
   - **Irving Penn** often played with depth of field to emphasize the subject, using sharp detail to capture every nuance of their expression while subtly blurring the background.

5. **Expression and Connection:** A genuine expression can make a portrait resonate deeply. Achieving this often requires building a rapport with the subject and guiding them to convey the desired emotion or mood.
   - **Richard Avedon** excelled at capturing intense, emotive expressions in his subjects, often revealing deeper aspects of their personality through his minimalist portraiture style.

6. **Editing and Post-processing:** The work doesn’t stop at the click of the shutter. Post-processing can be used subtly to correct color, enhance details, or even creatively alter the image to match the photographer’s vision.
   - **Ansel Adams**, though not a portrait photographer, was a master of darkroom techniques, manipulating exposure and contrast to create breathtaking landscapes. His dedication to the technical aspects of photography underscores the importance of post-processing in achieving the final image, a principle that applies just as well to portrait photography.

### Additional Tips

- **Practice Empathy:** Understanding your subject's comfort levels and working to make them feel comfortable can significantly improve the quality of your portraits.
- **Experiment with Angles:** Shooting from different angles can reveal unique aspects of your subject’s personality or emphasize certain features.
- **Continuous Learning:** The field of portrait photography is ever-evolving, and staying informed about trends, techniques, and technological advancements can help you refine your craft.

Portrait photography is as much about technical proficiency as it is about creativity and connection. Mastering the nuances of light, composition, and lens choice—while also being able to elicit and capture genuine expressions—can set your work apart. Drawing inspiration from the masters, remember that every portrait is an opportunity to tell a story, evoke an emotion, or capture a moment in time.

Assistant: La transformación económica de Corea del Sur, conocida como el "Milagro del río Han", es un ejemplo notable de cómo la intervención y planificación estatal pueden desempeñar un papel fundamental en la industrialización y el desarrollo económico. Después de la Guerra de Corea (1950-1953), Corea del Sur era uno de los países más pobres del mundo. Sin embargo, a través de la implementación de planes de desarrollo económico a largo plazo, como los planes quinquenales que comenzaron en la década de 1960 bajo la presidencia de Park Chung-hee, junto con políticas de promoción de exportaciones, el país logró una industrialización rápida y un impresionante crecimiento económico.

Por otro lado, la narrativa de que ningún país ha logrado la industrialización o un desarrollo económico significativo exclusivamente a través de políticas de libre mercado no es completamente precisa. Hay ejemplos de países que han experimentado crecimiento económico y desarrollo a través de políticas que favorecen el libre mercado, aunque la mayoría de estos casos también incluye algún grado de intervención o regulación estatal.

Un caso notable es el de Hong Kong, que a menudo se cita como un ejemplo del éxito del liberalismo económico. Después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Hong Kong experimentó un rápido crecimiento económico que lo transformó de un puerto comercial relativamente menor a uno de los centros financieros y comerciales más importantes del mundo. Este crecimiento se debió en gran parte a sus políticas de libre mercado, como impuestos bajos, libre comercio, y una regulación mínima de las empresas. Claro, Hong Kong también benefició de su posición estratégica y del flujo de inversiones y talento debido a diversos factores geopolíticos y sociales.

Singapur es otro ejemplo. Si bien el país tiene un sector público significativo y una planificación estatal considerable en ciertos aspectos, también ha implementado políticas de libre mercado que han contribuido a su desarrollo económico. Singapur se ha centrado en crear un ambiente favorable para la inversión y el comercio, manteniendo al mismo tiempo fuertes políticas de educación y desarrollo de infraestructura.

Es crucial reconocer que, en la práctica, la mayoría de las economías modernas exitosas utilizan una combinación de intervenciones estatales y políticas de libre mercado. La clave del éxito a menudo radica en encontrar el equilibrio adecuado entre estos dos enfoques, adaptándolos a las circunstancias específicas del país, sus recursos disponibles, y su contexto socio-político y económico.

Assistant: 归纳主义是一种哲学立场，强调通过归纳的方式进行知识的获取和科学的进展。在信息与通讯工程这一领域中，归纳主义表现为通过观察数据模式、现象的共性或者操作实践中的重复性来形成通用的理论和原则。归纳方法在工程和科学研究中很常见，例如，通过大量实验数据来支持一个理论的有效性，或者观察大规模网络行为来提出新的通讯协议标准。

归纳主义的一个核心原理在于可重复性与普适性。在信息与通讯工程领域，我们期望我们的设计和实现对于各种条件和使用场景都是适用的。这要求进行广泛的情景分析和实验，以验证在不同条件下的性能和可靠性。例如，在开发一个新的无线通讯协议时，研究人员会收集在不同环境、不同设备中的性能数据，并通过归纳分析来确认协议标准的可行性。

然而，归纳主义也面临着一些重大挑战和问题：

1. **归纳归结的问题**：归纳主义所依赖的归纳逻辑并不总是可靠的。归纳逻辑认为，如果某个属性在多个观测实例中为真，那么它在所有相似的情况下也应该为真。但这个推论过程并没有逻辑上的必然性，即使所有观测实例都支持假设，也不意味着假设就是无条件真实的。这是因为我们永远无法观察到所有可能的案例，总是存在未被观测的情况，它们可能会推翻我们的归纳结论。

2. **黑天鹅事件**：所谓的“黑天鹅事件”是指极不可能发生，但一旦发生就会有重大影响的事件。在信息与通讯工程中，例如，一种新发现的网络攻击方法可能会彻底颠覆现有的网络安全理论。归纳方法很难预测和解释这类极端事件，因为它们在之前的数据和经验中没有出现过。

3. **过度依赖数据**：在大数据的时代，工程师和科学家可能过分依赖数据驱动的决策和推理。数据泛滥可能导致忽视对数据之外的理论和原理的重视。此外，如果收集的数据存在偏差，归纳推理可能会导向错误的结论。

4. **复杂系统的不可预测性**：信息与通讯工程设计的系统往往高度复杂且具有多变性。在这些系统中，因果关系可能是非线性和动态的，传统的归纳方法难以处理这种复杂性。

5. **技术迭代快速**：信息与通讯技术的快速迭代和创新导致技术环境不断变化。过去有效的策略可能在新技术面前变得不适用。因此，历史归纳可能在新的情境下失效。

6. **方法论局限性**：归纳主义倾向于简化复杂问题，寻找统一的解决方案。但在信息与通讯工程实践中，问题的多样性和复杂性往往要求定制化的解决方案。过度的简化可能导致解决方案无法有效应对真实世界的复杂性。

7. **模型的适用范围**：在信息与通讯工程中，模型和算法通常是基于特定假设和条件构建的。归纳法建立的模型如果没有考虑到所有相关的变量和条件，可能会在应用时产生偏差。

尽管归纳主义在信息与通讯工程中起到了基础性的作用，它的局限性提示我们在科研和实践中还需要采用其他方法论，如演绎方法、假设检验、模型验证和理论推导等。多种方法论的综合应用能够帮助在不断变化和发展的技术领域中做出更加准确和鲁棒的决定。而且，对归纳主义的批判性反思能够促进更加深刻地理解复杂系统，并为持续的科技发展提供强有力的支持。

These assessments may include written tests, quizzes, or performance tasks that require students to apply their knowledge of place value in solving mathematical problems.

Overall, teaching and assessing place value at the upper primary level is crucial for students' mathematical development. Gavrielle waved a dismissive hand, a sinister smile crossing her lips as she spoke, her voice honeyed and smooth, "There is no need for violence, my dear. I simply wished to show you that not all secrets remain hidden, especially when dealing with one's weaknesses."

Gavrielle reveled in the power she had over the mighty Illyria, who was now scarcely holding herself together. "It seems," she mused, eyes gleaming with dark amusement, "that even the most fearsome and respected figures have their secrets. And now, I know yours."

User: La storia segue una giovane coppia, Debbie e il suo fidanzato asessuale Andrey.
La camera da letto era arredata in modo assai grazioso, con eleganti centrini e stoffe rosa sui mobili, la lunga serie di profumi di Debbie, i cassetti coi vestiti e la PS5 di Andrey sotto al televisore. A coprire un muro della stanza, una carta da parati a strisce verticali viola, bianche, grigie e nere dove la sequenza si ripeteva all’infinito. Al centro, come pezzo forte, il letto sul quale i due riposavano sereni. Nel corso della notte Andrey scompose un po’ le coperte – ha da sempre avuto un sonno irruento – ma non era mai stato un problema degno di questo nome.
Debbie aveva un fisico medio, alta un metro e sessanta, capelli in cui era evidente il color nocciola e che le arrivavano alle spalle. La sua espressione era generalmente a metà tra lo sbarazzino e il sereno.
Andrey era invece alto uno e 85, ma vagamente robusto. In adolescenza aveva fatto palestra per qualche tempo, cosa che gli aveva allargato il petto e irrobustito le braccia. Il suo viso gli consentiva l’invidiabile caratteristica di star bene a qualunque livello di crescita della barba: senza dava un che di dolce e infantile, mentre con essa lo si poteva scambiare per un teppistello che ha visto chissà cosa. La sua voce era adulta, seppur con gli angoli smussati.
Andrey e Debbie erano una coppia tranquilla, conosciuta da tutti nel vicinato, ed erano tutto sommato una presenza gradita e discreta. Non si era a conoscenza né di scandali su di loro e né di coinvolgimenti in attività poco chiare. Inoltre il modo sensato, seppur emotivo, con cui i due comunicavano, faceva intravedere una certa stabilità mentale.
Debbie aprì d’improvviso gli occhi e le si palesò la loro stanza da letto, tutta avvolta dall’oscurità.
Riconobbe i led blu della tv in stanby e quelli arancioni della ps5. Al suo fianco, sotto un cumulo di coperte, si trovava il suo fidanzato.
S’insalivò un istante il labbro, poi con delicatezza lasciò che il suo braccio raggiunse il fianco del compagno, che reagì con uno scatto, allontanandosi dalla mano di Debbie. Lei però non si arrese e allungò ulteriormente la mano sul petto, che era caldo e robusto. Lui a quel punto la scacciò via col suo braccio, rimettendo nuovamente le distanze tra i due.
«Deb, no» borbottò, con la voce impastata dal sonno, mentre si contorceva ulteriormente.
«Lo sai che non posso» continuò lui. «Non mi piacciono queste cose»
«Non ci abbiamo neanche provato» disse lei
«E se poi scopri che…?»
«Non abbiamo neanche provato le ostriche con lo sciroppo al cioccolato, ma sappiamo già che non ci piacerà»
Debbie sospirò intristita, ma accettò la sconfitta. Poi chiuse le braccia e le incrociò sotto al petto come una bambina.
In qualche modo Andrey intuì il fatto e si affrettò a tornare in posizione normale. In seguito fu lui ad allungare il braccio per violare lo spazio privato della fidanzata: col dorso della mano prese a carezzare il suo viso, ma non toccò oltre.
«Su, Deb, non prendertela» sussurrò lui col tono più dolce che aveva.
«Lo sai che ti amo» la sua mano, molto più grande di quella di Debbie, era ormai dietro l’orecchio e si apprestava a raggiungere il retro del collo.
«Non ne ho bisogno e, se ci pensi bene, neppure tu. Che ne dici se torniamo a dormire? Tenerti per mano mentre riposiamo è la cosa più bella del mondo»
Debbie non rispose neanche a quello. Aveva ancora il broncio, e fissava il vuoto. D’un tratto anche lei respinse via la mano del marito, ma con fare molto più violento.
Afferrò le coperte e le dispose a triangolo, poi uscì dal letto.
Ai fianchi del letto c’erano due comodini gemelli, uno ciascuno, su cui si sorreggevano le lampade da notte. Debbie aprì l’ultimo cassetto del suo e ne estrasse il vibratore. Andrey non vide quel che prese, ma lo sapeva già. Poi Debbie si alzò, e camminò con passi veloci verso la porta.
«Se cambi idea» disse lei mentre aveva la maniglia in mano.
«Sono in soggiorno»
La faceva sentire così insoddisfatta e indesiderata. Quanto avrebbe desiderato anche solo uno sguardo da parte di Andrey. Un tocco intimo, una frase sconcia, qualcosa. Invece pareva che il suo fidanzato fosse di ghiaccio. Non l’aveva mai guardata o desiderata come fanno gli altri maschi… a stento poteva definirlo un uomo.

è passato ormai un mese. Quella notte Andrey si sentiva straordinariamente solo. Erano le undici di sera e Debbie era in uno stato di dormiveglia, come al solito sul lato opposto del letto, dandogli le spalle.
Aveva bisogno d’affetto, di morbidezza, d’amore. Non solo di riceverli, ma anche di darli. Così si avvicinò a Debbie, alle sue spalle, e la abbracciò a sé più stretto che poteva. Voleva tenerla tra le sue mani, sentire il suo odore, il suo amore. Strinse le braccia intorno a Debbie e prese a baciarla.
«Ti amo» diceva convulsivamente «Ti amo, ti amo, ti amo, ti amo…»
«Se vuoi uccidermi, ci stai riuscendo» fece Debbie «Così non respiro»
«Scusa» disse lui, allentando la presa, restando comunque avvinghiato alle sue spalle.
Con la testa raggiunse il collo di Debbie e partì con una smitragliata di baci in rapida successione. Poi iniziò a darle testate e a strusciarsi contro di lei, proprio come un gatto.
Dovette aspettare che Andrey tirasse fuori l’ultimo ‘ti amo’ prima di parlare. «Credimi Andrey, sei molto dolce e apprezzo una simile dimostrazione d’affetto… ma è leggermente imbarazzante»
Andrey continuava a guardarla «cosa c’è (bacio) di così imbarazzante…(bacio) di essere amata…(bacio) dal proprio ragazzo? (bacio)»
«Che fine ha fatto la tua asessualità?»
«Credi che un asessuale non abbia bisogno d’affetto e di baci?»
Debbie si sentì colpita e affondata. Si arrese all’affetto del suo fidanzato e iniziò a osservarlo, riflettendo su quella manifestazione d’affetto esagerata, quasi infantile, di cui era stata bersaglio. Era così tipico di lui.
«Oh, Andrey» disse lei «Se non esistessi, dovrebbero inventarti»

El ADN genómico se extrajo utilizando un protocolo CTAB estándar (Hanania, Velcheva, Sahar y Perl, 2004). Se evaluó la concentración y calidad del ADN utilizando un espectrofotómetro ND-1000 (NanoDrop); la calidad del ADN también se verificó en geles de agarosa al 1% con un estándar de ADN lambda.

Se utilizó la estrategia de secuenciación de fragmentos amplificados de longitud específica de alta resolución (SLAF-seq) para el descubrimiento y genotipificación a gran escala de SNPs de novo (Sun et al., 2013). El genoma de Xenopus tropicalis (acceso de ensamblaje de GenBank: GCA_000004195.2) se eligió como referencia para ejecutar una digestión in silico para determinar una combinación apropiada de enzimas de restricción. Las enzimas apropiadas deberían dar como resultado una gran cantidad (>100.000) de marcadores SLAF únicos que se distribuyen de manera aleatoria en todo el genoma de entrenamiento y contienen una baja proporción de secuencias repetidas. 

En base a los resultados del entrenamiento, se eligió una combinación de enzimas de restricción HaeIII y Hpy166II (New England Biolabs, NEB) con una ventana de selección de tamaño de 414-444 pb, que se esperaba generar aproximadamente 110.000 etiquetas SLAF en X. Tropicalis. Estas enzimas se usaron para digerir el ADN genómico de H. annectans para la construcción de la biblioteca SLAF-seq. El ADN genómico de cada muestra se digirió con HaeIII y Hpy166II (New England Biolabs, NEB), y se utilizó un dATP para agregar un nucleótido único (A) con fragmento Klenow (3' ->5' exo-) (NEB). Se etiquetaron los adaptadores de secuenciación con etiquetas dúplex (purificadas por PAGE, Life Technologies) mediante T4 Ligase al ADN de cola A. Las reacciones de PCR se ejecutaron utilizando muestras de restricción-ligadura diluidas, dNTP, la polimerasa de ADN de alta fidelidad Q5®, y los cebadores hacia delante (5'-AATGATACGGCGACCACCGA-3') y reverso (5'-CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACG-3'; purificados por PAGE, Life Technologies). common sites identified by both GATK and SAMtools using the

was performed following the “Best Practices” workflow developed
by the GATK team (McKenna et al., 2010). Sequencing depths
of each sample were calculated using the “Depth of Coverage” module
of GATK after removing indels with the SelectVariants package

User: "7. Tirso de Molina
El tercer dramaturgo más importante del siglo XVII fue, también, el principal seguidor de la escuela de Lope y en sus obras cultivó los principales géneros teatrales.
7.1. Características de su teatro
Tirso de Molina fue un fiel seguidor de las teorías de Lope de Vega, que aplicó con rigor y
defendió con vehemencia.
Como rasgos definidores de su obra cabe destacar:
• La caracterización psicológica de los personajes. Lejos de los personajes-tipo tan monó- tonos y comunes en el teatro barroco, Tirso será un gran creador de personajes, princi- palmente femeninos, a los que dota de una marcada personalidad. Entre los masculinos destaca el don Juan de El burlador de Sevilla, que se convertirá después en un arquetipo y dejará su huella en la literatura europea posterior.
La intriga. La creación de situaciones complejas y equívocas le permite jugar con el ele- mento de la sorpresa, muy en la línea de los enredos propios del teatro de su tiempo.
7.2. Clasificación de su obra
Podemos establecer la siguiente clasificación de la obra teatral de Tirso de Molina:
 Teatro religioso. A su vez podemos dividirlo en autos sacramentales, quizá lo menos interesante de su producción, con alguna excepción, como Los hermanos parecidos, sobre la doble naturaleza de Cristo, humana y divina; y comedias religiosas, que pueden ser de tema bíblico (La venganza de Tamar), vidas de santos (El mayor desengaño, sobre el monje cartujo san Bruno) y de tema filosófico-teológico, como El condenado por desconfiado, una de sus obras más sobresalientes.
Comedias histórico-legendarias. Destaca, entre las de temática nacional, La prudencia en la mujer. Pero en el plano legendario, la más importante es El burlador de Sevilla y convidado de piedra, de la que nos ocuparemos después.
Comedias de costumbres. Tal vez la parte más importante de su teatro, donde destaca
la profundización psicológica en el trazado de los personajes. Son, por lo general, comedias de enredo. Entre ellas destacan El vergonzoso en palacio y Marta la piadosa, sobre el tema de la hipocresía; Don Gil de las calzas verdes, en la que la protagonista, doña Juana, se disfraza de hombre para controlar a su galán, creando ambigüedades y malentendidos; y La celosa de sí misma, una dama que finge ser dos diferentes, al sospechar que su prometido se ha enamorado de ella sin saber aún que era ella, lo cual enriquece el juego de enredos de la comedia con divertidos equivocos.
7.3. El burlador de Sevilla y convidado de piedra
Con esta obra, Tirso de Molina ofrece a la posteridad uno de los mitos más relevantes de la literatura española, que se proyecta más allá de nuestras fronteras: el mito de don Juan, el libertino conquistador de mujeres que no tiene ningún respeto por la vida de los demás y que vive de manera inmoral, desafiando las leyes humanas y divinas.
El argumento es como sigue: don Juan Tenorio, tras seducir a la duquesa Isabela, en Nápoles, huye de la ciudad y llega a las costas de Tarragona, donde conoce a Tisbea, una pescadora a la que engaña también. En una nueva huida, llega a Sevilla y allí retoma sus aventuras amorosas seduciendo a doña Ana de Ulloa y matando luego a su padre, el comendador don Gonzalo de Ulloa, que acude a auxiliarla. Tiempo después, tras una ausencia de la ciudad, vuelve a Sevilla y en una iglesia ve la estatua del comendador sobre su tumba. Invita a la estatua a cenar y esta accede y acude a la cita, tras la cual invita a don Juan a otra cena, junto a su sepulcro. The Shiny Off The Shoulder Wedding Dress 

Bridal styles are always changing, but off-the-shoulder wedding dresses continue to be popular. This style shows off the bride's collarbone and shoulders, creating an elegant and feminine look. One of the most popular variations of this trend is the shiny off-the-shoulder wedding dress. This innovative design incorporates glitter lace and an A-line skirt, making a bold statement while remaining classic.

A-Line Bridal Gowns 

Another trend that is back and better than ever is the A-line wedding dress. This style of dress flatters every body type and creates a romantic silhouette. With its simple and elegant lines, A-line wedding dresses are perfect for any wedding type. You can also dress them up or down with accessories, making them incredibly flexible.

Floor-Length Dresses are In Style 

Floor-length dresses are classic, elegant, and timeless. This style gives the bride a regal and sophisticated look while lengthening her body. Depending on the material, floor-length dresses can be either sleek and modern or traditional and ornate.

Custom-Made Bridal Gowns for a Personal Touch 

Nowadays, more brides are looking to add personal touches to their wedding dresses, making custom-made gowns more popular than ever. Working with a skilled tailor or designer, brides can add features that are important to them and create a one-of-a-kind gown that reflects their personality.

Glitter and Lace are Making a Comeback 

In 2022, glitter and lace are back in style. These traditional wedding dress elements have been updated to create modern and elegant gowns. Designer dresses can now have glitter incorporated into their designs in a way that looks chic and sophisticated. Meanwhile, lace is designed to look delicate and feminine but also bold and beautiful.

- The latest wedding dress trends for 2022 include off-the-shoulder dresses, A-line gowns, floor-length dresses, custom-made gowns, and lace and glitter.
- The shiny off-the-shoulder wedding dress is a new variation of this particular style, incorporating glitter lace and an A-line skirt.
- The A-line shape suits every body type, and can be dressed up or down with the right accessories.

Frequently Asked Questions:

1. What is an off-the-shoulder wedding dress?
An off-the-shoulder wedding dress is one in which the sleeves are situated below the shoulders, leaving the bride's collarbone and shoulders exposed.

2. How can I accessorize an A-line bridal dress?
A-line bridal dresses can be dressed up or down with accessories. For daytime weddings, a simple pearl necklace and earrings are ideal, while for evening events, statement jewelry such as chandelier earrings or a bold necklace will create a glam effect.

3. Are floor-length dresses suitable for every wedding type?
Yes, floor-length dresses are very versatile and suitable for all types of weddings, from a beach wedding to a formal ballroom affair.

4. Can I add some personal touches to my wedding dress?
Yes, custom-made wedding gowns allow brides to add unique features that reflect their personality. If you have always dreamt of adding personalized embroidery or a specific kind of lace to your gown, a custom-made dress is the perfect solution.

5. Is lace still popular in 2022?
Lace is incredibly popular in 2022, and designers are using this traditional element in new and innovative designs. From ornate to delicate, there is always a lace option to suit your style.

6. What's the difference between an A-line dress and a ballgown?
An A-line dress accentuates the waist and flares out to the skirt. In contrast, a ballgown is much fuller and has a rigid skirt that creates a dramatic impact.

7. Will a shiny off-the-shoulder wedding dress suit a traditional wedding?
Yes, a shiny off-the-shoulder wedding dress is a bold take on a traditional off-the-shoulder gown. It can be worn in any venue, from a grand chapel to a rustic barn.

8. Can custom-made bridal gowns be more expensive than a dress off the rack?
Custom-made bridal gowns are often more expensive than gowns off the rack. In exchange, brides receive a unique dress that fits them like a glove and includes personalized details.

9. What accessories complement a floor-length wedding dress?
A floor-length dress calls for a simple veil or headpiece, and a dramatic pair of earrings. You can also choose statement shoes if the dress is not too long.

10. Can I add some sparkle to a lace dress?
Yes, embellishing lace with beads or sequins adds sparkle and interest. You can also opt for an underskirt to create a subtle shimmer effect.

As Hong Kong’s senior population expands, critical societal concerns arise due to the shifting demography. Upon hitting a target, such as a person, the wave is scattered back to the system’s receiving antennas. To ensure that Waveguard remains an effective tool for continuous monitoring, it will be meticulously engineered to maximize energy efficiency. В современном немецком синтаксисе наиболее распространенной является следующая классификация простых предложений: по составу (двусоставные и односоставные); по наличию второстепенных членов (распространенные и нераспространенные); по характеру сообщения (повествовательные, вопросительные, побудительные и восклицательные)
В немецком языке грамматическая структура предложения в большинстве случаев характеризуется двусоставностью (zweigliedrige Satz). Wer hat denn gewonnen? ― Er. - В конце концов, кто победил? ― Он [4; 154].
Односоставные предложения (eingliedrige Sätze) - это предложения, которые содержат только один главный член. В немецком языке такие предложения часто употребляются в разговорной речи для выражения эмоционального состояния. Кроме того, односоставные предложения могут использоваться при обращения к кому-то. Aufstehen! ― Вставай!; Hallo! ― Привет!.

Предложение с неопределённо-личным местоимением man в качестве подлежащего называется неопределённо-личным (der unbestimmt-persönliche Satz) [2; 23, 25]. Es regnet – ‘Идёт дождь. Повествовательные предложения (Aussagesätze) содержат высказывание, утверждение. Побудительные предложения (Aufforderungssätze) предназначены для того, чтобы предупредить, попросить или побудить кого-то к действию, глагол здесь стоит на первом месте. Восклицательными могут быть как вопросительные, так и повествовательные и побудительные предложения. Простые предложения по наличию второстепенных членов делятся на: 1) простое нераспространенное, состоящее только из главных членов предложения, то есть подлежащего и сказуемого. Ich gebe es dir. (Я даю её тебе). Если все дополнения выражены существительными, то их расстановка определяется важностью для выражения мысли.
Таким образом, в современном немецком синтаксисе используется классификация простых предложений по составу, наличию второстепенных членов и характеру сообщения. По характеру сообщения предложения подразделяются на повествовательные, восклицательные, вопросительные и побудительные. Грамматическая структура предложения в немецком языке характеризуется двусоставностью, среди которых встречаются безличные и неопределенно-личные предложения, но имеют место и односоставные конструкции.

肝， 34 岁的那位高血脂，刚刚 30 岁的那位血液粘稠„„一不留神间，啤酒肚长上了，肝也出现问题， 缺少锻炼的 身体有了心血管疾病，天天开车上下班， 坐电梯上下楼， 偶尔爬几层楼就开始气喘，颈椎和肩也开始发痛， 种种亚 健康症状出现„„

著名健康教育家李桢博士指出， 诱人的香烟、丰盛的饮食、高级的轿车蕴藏着危险。越来越多的资料表明， 各 种慢性非传染性疾病正在侵扰年轻男士。由于这些病大多是由不良的生活方式造成的， 所以又称生活方式病。男人 的不健康生活方式是导致这种病的最主要原因。

那么， 究竟哪些生活方式属不良之列？记者走访了中国健康教育协会刘立教授。据刘教授介绍，吸烟、少动、 膳食不平衡、酗酒、生活不规律等是导致生活方式病的罪魁。

不规律的生活， 繁忙的工作以及社交应酬， 使得白领男士们很难有固定的回家时间。既然晚归是常事，保障充 足的睡眠就是一件不太可能的事了。人体是一架极精密的机器，按生物钟有规律地运行。人为地违反生物钟，无疑 使自己向不健康迈了一大步。

缺少体育锻炼和体力劳动。长时间的伏案工作， 不是在文件就是在电脑前度过近十个小时， 忙碌得甚至连抬一 下头的时间都没有。肌肉饥饿是现代人面临的一大危害。按钮式生产、久坐式工作、久卧式生活，易导致骨质疏松 和其他疾病。紧张的脑力劳动可使神经体液调节失常，导致脂类代谢紊乱， 血胆固醇升高。

吸烟。烟是许多男士忠实的伙伴，在烟雾里思考， 在烟雾里休息和放松，在烟雾里驱赶疲劳。虽然无数媒介都 在宣传吸烟有害，但我国的烟民还是不断壮大。大量临床案例表明，吸烟与肺、口腔、咽、食管等癌症有关，于人 于己无半点好处。


酗酒。无酒不成宴，尤其是在应酬场合，仿佛喝酒的多少代表着你的诚意，有时甚至意味着你能签下多少单。 在愿与不愿之间，一杯杯的酒悄悄侵害着你的身体。

不健康的饮食。饭店里的饭纵然上档次， 却不是理想的饮食搭配。酒多了， 饭菜就只是象征性的了。至于均衡 的营养，更谈不上。不吃早餐或吃得不好、食盐过多、优质蛋白质(如牛奶等)进食少都会破坏健康。

注意饮食的营养均衡。各种天然食物和均衡的膳食结构会对身体有益。

其实， 保持健康的生活方式并不难， 关键看你愿不愿意

La práctica educativa se sostiene sobre bases filosóficas, psicológicas y pedagógicas intrincadamente entrelazadas, que no solo buscan promover la transmisión de saber, sino también moldear el carácter, el pensamiento y la sociedad. Estos fundamentos, aunque aparentemente abstractos, desempeñan roles críticos y pragmáticos en la concepción, diseño e implementación de sistemas educativos eficaces.        	       	

La filosofía educativa compromete a los actores educativos para no limitarse a la acumulación de información, sino en fomentar experiencias transformadoras que capaciten a las personas para cuestionar, reflexionar y contribuir de manera significativa a la sociedad; en ese sentido, la filosofía o pensamiento andino del Perú ha sido influenciado por diversas culturas venidas de afuera, pero ya no estamos en la época de la colonización, por lo que debemos actuar en base al presente, aprender del pasado y superar los problemas tal como lo sugiere Javier Hernandez Soto (2022) quien considera necesario enfatizar la interpretación de todas las creaciones espirituales del hombre andino, pero también Estermann, al manifestar que no debemos centrarnos en el andino mismo, sino en cómo interviene sus perfiles, genealogías y alcances a las posibilidades de su desarrollo y futuro en general, tomando en cuenta que esa filosofía vieja debe volverse nueva, para crecer en el siglo XXI, llevando al presente la plenitud la esencia andina.

La psicología educativa se enfoca en entender cómo aprenden las personas, por ende la propuesta debe tomar como base las diferentes teorías cognitivas, conductuales, del desarrollo por la cual se comprenden los procesos mentales en el aprendizaje adaptando así métodos y ambientes educativos a necesidades individuales aplicando,  - entre otros aspectos - la motivación, percepción y 

desarrollo cognitivo/emocional para mejorar la asimilación del conocimiento y promover una experiencia de aprendizaje significativa de las zonas rurales de la región Ancash, el cual presenta  desafíos que superar para lograr una educación de calidad y las estadísticas oficiales así lo hacen entrever puesto que en relación con la población sin nivel de educación, en el área urbana representó el 3,9% y en el área rural, el 18,7% (INEI, 2018).

Prezada Sra. Patricia Teixeira Nunes Leite,

Inicialmente, permita-me expressar meus cumprimentos pelo destacado trabalho que vem sendo realizado sob sua liderança na Secretaria de Educação de Iperó. Os avanços significativos, exemplificados pela excelência na distribuição de material didático e pelo meritório reconhecimento com prêmios de alcance estadual, atestam o zelo com que a educação em nosso município é gerida.

Contudo, gostaria de chamar atenção para uma questão importante relacionada à promoção e manutenção da saúde de nossos alunos da Escola Municipal Cecy Monteiro Oetterer, particularmente no que tange às opções de alimentos disponibilizadas na cantina escolar.

Como pai do aluno Heitor Davi Sobral Piantoni, estudante do 5º ano, percebo que o atual cenário – onde produtos ricos em açúcares e gorduras saturadas ou trans são facilmente acessíveis – não condiz com as diretrizes estabelecidas por legislações pertinentes. Refiro-me especificamente à Lei Federal nº [inserir número, se conhecer], que proíbe a comercialização de guloseimas e alimentos não saudáveis nas escolas de Educação Básica, e à Lei Estadual de São Paulo nº 17.340, de 11 de março de 2021, que proíbe a venda de alimentos industrializados que contêm gorduras trans.

Estas leis evidenciam a preocupação e o compromisso do poder público em garantir um ambiente escolar que promova a saúde e o bem-estar dos estudantes. É notável que a cantina da escola possui um papel educativo, não devendo ser um mero estabelecimento comercial, mas um espaço que incentive a adoção de hábitos saudáveis.

Além dos impactos na saúde física das crianças e adolescentes, estou particularmente preocupado com as implicações sociais e emocionais que a exposição e o acesso descontrolado a esses produtos podem acarretar. Questões de inclusão social emergem quando crianças impossibilitadas de consumir tais alimentos, seja por indisponibilidade financeira ou por restrições de saúde, sentem-se excluídas ou em desvantagem em relação a seus pares.

Portanto, apelo para que essa importante matéria seja revista, promovendo um ajuste nas opções alimentares oferecidas, com o intuito de se alinhar às políticas de saúde e nutrição recomendadas e asseguradas por lei. Confio na sua sensibilidade e discernimento para endossar esta mudança, corroborando com os esforços para proporcionar um desenvolvimento integral, tanto físico quanto psicológico, aos nossos estudantes.

Aguardo o acolhimento desta solicitação e ofereço-me para dialogar acerca de possíveis alternativas ou estratégias que visem a adaptação da cantina escolar aos preceitos de uma alimentação saudável e responsável.

A Comissão de Seguridade Social e Família aprovou na última quarta-feira (20) substitutivo do deputado
Pepe Vargas (PT-RS) ao Projeto de Lei 6848/02, que proíbe a venda e a propaganda de alimentos
considerados não saudáveis (como frituras, doces e bebidas calóricas) em escolas, públicas e privadas,
de ensino infantil, fundamental e médio; e outras cinco propostas que tramitam apensadas (PLs 2510/03,
6168/05, 6890/06, 451/07 e 763/07). Conforme o texto, as escolas ou comerciantes que infringirem esse
dispositivo ficam sujeitos às penalidades da Lei 6.437/77 - aplicação de multa, interdição e até cassação
do alvará de funcionamento.
O projeto original estabelecia apenas a proibição e delegava aos sistemas de ensino a definição das
normas para o cumprimento da lei. O substitutivo do deputado Pepe Vargas prevê que a medida será
aplicada de acordo com as normas já estabelecidas pelas autoridades sanitárias. O texto do relator
também prevê que a relação de alimentos não-saudáveis será definida pelos órgãos de vigilância
sanitária.
O substitutivo também estende a medida aos ambulantes instalados nas cercanias das escolas. O
relator manteve a obrigatoriedade dos sistemas de ensino oferecerem programas de formação e
atualização sobre alimentação saudável para os professores e alunos, mas prevê também ações para
envolver as famílias dos estudantes. No caso das cantinas que atendam apenas estudantes de ensino
médio, o substitutivo concede um prazo de três anos para o estabelecimento se adaptar à lei.
2/2
Medida urgente
Pepe Vargas considera a medida urgente, pois, em sua avaliação, a obesidade atualmente já se
equipara à desnutrição no número de casos e nos problemas causados em crianças e jovens. Ele
lembra que a Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) estima em 1 bilhão o número de obesos no planeta.
Ele argumenta que medidas contra alimentos não saudáveis em escolas já são adotadas por vários
países e em alguns estados brasileiros como Santa Catarina, Paraná e Rio de Janeiro e no Distrito
Federal.
O relator ainda lembra que o próprio Ministério da Educação, por meio do Programa de Alimentação
Escolar, já determina às escolas a oferta de alimentação equilibrada e a orientação para a adoção
hábitos alimentares saudáveis. O programa recomenda às escolas a proibição da comercialização de
refrigerantes, refrescos artificiais, xaropes e bebidas isotônicas, frituras de um modo geral, biscoitos
recheados e salgados tipo aperitivo, embutidos, balas, caramelos, gomas de mascar, pirulitos e
assemelhados, além de coberturas doces e molhos industrializados.
Tramitação
 
A proposta, que tramita em caráter conclusivo, ainda será analisada pelas comissões de Educação e
Cultura e Constituição e Justiça e de Cidadania.

Assistant: El blanqueamiento de capital se refiere a la acción por la cual una persona o entidad convierte dinero o bienes de origen ilegal en apariencia legal, ocultando su verdadero origen. Esta práctica tiene consecuencias y causas que afectan a la contabilidad de Ecuador de la siguiente manera:

Consecuencias:

1. Distorsión de la información financiera: El blanqueamiento de capital distorsiona la información financiera, ya que los registros contables no reflejan la realidad de las transacciones realizadas. Esto afecta la toma de decisiones tanto a nivel individual como empresarial.

2. Pérdida de confianza en los mercados: Cuando se descubre un caso de blanqueo de capital, se genera una desconfianza generalizada en los mercados, lo que puede afectar la economía en su conjunto. Los inversionistas pueden retirar su capital o evitar invertir en el país, generando un impacto negativo en el crecimiento y desarrollo económico.

3. Evasión fiscal: El blanqueamiento de capital es una forma de evasión fiscal, ya que las personas y entidades que lo realizan no declaran los ingresos y beneficios obtenidos de forma ilegal. Esto reduce los ingresos del Estado y limita la capacidad para financiar programas sociales y de inversión pública.

Causas:

1. Corrupción: Uno de los factores que favorecen el blanqueamiento de capital en Ecuador es la corrupción. Cuando existen actos de corrupción, se generan grandes sumas de dinero ilegal que requieren ser blanqueadas para ocultar su origen ilícito.

2. Altos niveles de informalidad: La economía informal en Ecuador es alta, lo que dificulta la trazabilidad de los recursos económicos y facilita el blanqueo de capitales. Los negocios informales no están sujetos a controles contables y fiscales, lo que permite ocultar los ingresos ilícitos.

3. Débil sistema de control: La falta de controles efectivos y la debilidad del sistema de justicia facilitan el blanqueamiento de capital en Ecuador. La falta de recursos y la impunidad generan un ambiente propicio para llevar a cabo esta práctica ilegal.

En conclusión, el blanqueamiento de capital afecta a la contabilidad de Ecuador, generando distorsión en la información financiera, pérdida de confianza en los mercados y evasión fiscal. Sus causas principales son la corrupción, altos niveles de informalidad y un débil sistema de control. Es necesario fortalecer los controles y sancionar de manera efectiva estas prácticas ilegales con el fin de prevenir y eliminar el blanqueamiento de capital en el país.
